~~~~~java
package it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.topflop;

import it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.config.MiniJson;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.MathContext;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Historical player facts for explicitly approved identities and a 3.2 site cutoff.
 * Real-life votes/events are counted once per FCA player and Serie A day (as
 * already consolidated in Careers). Fantasy contributions are NEVER summed
 * across teams/competitions into a fictitious player total; every row retains
 * its original fantasy team, competition, and season.
 */
public final class TopFlopHistoricalViews {
    private TopFlopHistoricalViews() {}
    private static final MathContext MC=MathContext.DECIMAL64;
    private static final String SHARD_PREFIX="a.push(...[";
    private static final List<String> EVENTS=List.of("GOLFATTI1","GOLFATTISURIGORE1","ASSIST",
        "GOLSUBITI","GOLSUBITISURIGORE","RIGPAR","RIGSBA","AUTOGOL1","AMM","ESP");

    static final class Career {
        final String identityId;
        final List<Map<String,Object>> seasons=new ArrayList<>();
        final List<Map<String,Object>> fantasyContexts=new ArrayList<>();
        final Set<String> seenContexts=new HashSet<>();
        final List<Map<String,Object>> anomalies=new ArrayList<>();
        int verifiedRealFantasyVotes;
        BigDecimal verifiedRealFantasySum=BigDecimal.ZERO;
        final Set<String> verifiedRealRules=new HashSet<>();
        BigDecimal votes=BigDecimal.ZERO;
        int valid=0;
        int costObservations=0;
        BigDecimal costSum=BigDecimal.ZERO,costMin=null,costMax=null;
        final Map<String,BigDecimal> events=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Career(String id){identityId=id;}
        void add(Map<String,Object> row) {
            Map<String,Object> real=asObject(row.get("reale"));
            int validSeason=asInt(real.get("votiValidi"));
            BigDecimal sum=asDecimal(real.get("sommaVoti"));
            if(validSeason<0 || sum.signum()<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Voti reali invalidi");
            valid+=validSeason;votes=votes.add(sum);
            Map<String,Object> srcEvents=asObject(real.get("eventi"));
            for(var e:srcEvents.entrySet())events.merge(e.getKey(),asDecimal(e.getValue()),BigDecimal::add);
            String key=String.valueOf(row.get("playerKey"));
            String season=seasonOf(key);
            if(row.get("stagione")!=null && !season.equals(String.valueOf(row.get("stagione"))))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stagione incoerente: " + key);
            Map<String,Object> seasonRow=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            seasonRow.put("stagione",season);seasonRow.put("playerKey",key);
            seasonRow.put("nome",String.valueOf(row.get("nome")));
            seasonRow.put("votiValidi",validSeason);seasonRow.put("sommaVoti",sum);
            seasonRow.put("mediaVoto",validSeason==0?null:sum.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(validSeason),MC));
            seasonRow.put("eventi",srcEvents);
            if(row.get("costoAcquisto") instanceof Map<?,?> cost) {
                Map<String,Object> values=asObject(cost);
                seasonRow.put("costoAcquisto",values);
                int n=asInt(values.get("registrazioniConCosto"));
                if(n>0) {
                    BigDecimal costAverage=asDecimal(values.get("medio"));
                    BigDecimal minimum=asDecimal(values.get("minimo")),maximum=asDecimal(values.get("massimo"));
                    costObservations+=n;
                    costSum=costSum.add(costAverage.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(n)));
                    if(costMin==null||costMin.compareTo(minimum)>0)costMin=minimum;
                    if(costMax==null||costMax.compareTo(maximum)<0)costMax=maximum;
                }
            }
            seasons.add(seasonRow);
        }
        void addTeam(Map<String,Object> row) {
            String playerKey=String.valueOf(row.get("playerKey"));
            String season=seasonOf(playerKey);
            int team=asInt(row.get("idSquadraInterno"));
            int competition=asInt(row.get("idCompetizioneInterno"));
            String unique=playerKey+":"+team+":"+competition;
            if(!seenContexts.add(unique))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contesto fantasy duplicato: "+unique);
            int counted=asInt(row.get("gareConteggiate"));
            int realValid=asInt(row.get("gareConVotoReale"));
            BigDecimal realVotes=asDecimal(row.get("sommaVotiRealiApportati"));
            BigDecimal fantasyVotes=asDecimal(row.get("sommaFantavotiApportati"));
            if(counted<0||realValid<0||realValid>counted)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Conteggi fantasy incoerenti: "+unique);
            Map<String,Object> context=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            context.put("stagione",season);
            context.put("playerKey",playerKey);
            context.put("idSquadraInterno",team);
            context.put("fantasquadra",row.get("fantasquadra"));
            context.put("idCompetizioneInterno",competition);
            context.put("competizione",row.get("competizione"));
            context.put("famiglia",row.get("famiglia"));
            context.put("gareConteggiate",counted);
            context.put("gareConVotoReale",realValid);
            context.put("mediaVotoApportata",realValid==0?null:realVotes.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(realValid),MC));
            context.put("fantamediaApportata",counted==0?null:fantasyVotes.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(counted),MC));
            context.put("sommaVotiRealiApportati",realVotes);
            context.put("sommaFantavotiApportati",fantasyVotes);
            context.put("panchinaNonConteggiata",asInt(row.get("panchinaNonConteggiata")));
            context.put("fuoriLista",asInt(row.get("fuoriLista")));
            if(row.containsKey("nonUtilizzatoOsservato"))
                context.put("nonUtilizzatoOsservato",row.get("nonUtilizzatoOsservato"));
            if(row.containsKey("costoAcquisto"))
                context.put("costoAcquisto",row.get("costoAcquisto"));
            fantasyContexts.add(context);
        }
        Map<String,Object> view() {
            Map<String,Object> result=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            result.put("playerIdentityId",identityId);
            result.put("identitaStoricaVerificata",true);
            result.put("stagioni",seasons);
            result.put("numeroStagioni",seasons.size());
            result.put("votiRealiValidi",valid);
            result.put("mediaVotoReale",valid==0?null:votes.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(valid),MC));
            result.put("eventiReali",events);
            result.put("gol",events.getOrDefault("GOLFATTI1",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("assist",events.getOrDefault("ASSIST",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("ammonizioni",events.getOrDefault("AMM",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("espulsioni",events.getOrDefault("ESP",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("autogol",events.getOrDefault("AUTOGOL1",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("rigoriSbagliati",events.getOrDefault("RIGSBA",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("golSubiti",events.getOrDefault("GOLSUBITI",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            result.put("rigoriParati",events.getOrDefault("RIGPAR",BigDecimal.ZERO));
            boolean complete=valid>0 && valid==verifiedRealFantasyVotes;
            result.put("fantamediaReale",complete?
                verifiedRealFantasySum.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(valid),MC):null);
            result.put("fantamediaRealeDisponibilita",complete?
                "FONTE_FCA_O_REGOLAMENTO_VERIFICATO_COPERTURA_COMPLETA":"FONTE_REALE_MANCANTE_O_COPERTURA_INCOMPLETA");
            result.put("votiFantamediaRealeCoperti",verifiedRealFantasyVotes);
            result.put("fontiRegolamentiReali",verifiedRealRules.stream().sorted().toList());
            result.put("anomalieStagionali",anomalies);
            Map<String,Object> costs=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            costs.put("registrazioniConCosto",costObservations);
            costs.put("minimo",costMin);costs.put("massimo",costMax);
            costs.put("medio",costObservations==0?null:costSum.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(costObservations),MC));
            costs.put("confrontabilita","PREZZI_REGISTRATI_NON_NORMALIZZATI_PER_BUDGET_STAGIONALE");
            result.put("costoAcquistoStorico",costs);
            result.put("fantasquadrePerStagione",fantasyContexts);
            result.put("contestiFantasyDistinti",fantasyContexts.size());
            result.put("aggregazioneFantasy","PER_FANTASQUADRA_COMPETIZIONE_STAGIONE_NO_TOTALE_GLOBALE");
            return result;
        }
    }
    /** Old entrypoint retained for 3.2/4.0 tests and consumers. */
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> aggregate(List<Map<String,Object>> seasonCareers,
                                                       Map<String,String> approved) {
        return aggregate(seasonCareers,List.of(),approved);
    }
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> aggregate(List<Map<String,Object>> seasonCareers,
                                                       List<Map<String,Object>> teams,
                                                       Map<String,String> approved) {
        return aggregate(seasonCareers,teams,approved,TopFlopSettings.defaults(),Set.of());
    }
    /** TF14/TF15 are produced only for explicit approved identities and selected records. */
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> aggregate(List<Map<String,Object>> seasonCareers,
                                                       List<Map<String,Object>> teams,
                                                       Map<String,String> approved,
                                                       TopFlopSettings settings,
                                                       Set<String> selectedIds) {
        return aggregate(seasonCareers,teams,approved,settings,selectedIds,List.of());
    }
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> aggregate(List<Map<String,Object>> seasonCareers,
                                                       List<Map<String,Object>> teams,
                                                       Map<String,String> approved,
                                                       TopFlopSettings settings,
                                                       Set<String> selectedIds,
                                                       List<Map<String,Object>> realFantasyRows) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(realFantasyRows);
        Objects.requireNonNull(settings);Objects.requireNonNull(selectedIds);
        Objects.requireNonNull(seasonCareers);Objects.requireNonNull(teams);Objects.requireNonNull(approved);
        Map<String,Career> byIdentity=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String,String> seenKeys=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(Map<String,Object> row:seasonCareers) {
            String key=String.valueOf(row.get("playerKey"));
            String identity=approved.get(key);
            if(identity==null)continue; // Never guess identity by raw code or name.
            if(seenKeys.putIfAbsent(key,identity)!=null)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Doppia anagrafica nello stesso cutoff: " + key);
            byIdentity.computeIfAbsent(identity,Career::new).add(row);
        }
        for(Map<String,Object> row:teams) {
            String key=String.valueOf(row.get("playerKey"));
            String identity=approved.get(key);
            if(identity==null)continue;
            Career career=byIdentity.get(identity);
            if(career==null || !seenKeys.containsKey(key))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contesto fantasy senza carriera FCA nello scope: "+key);
            career.addTeam(row);
        }
        Set<String> verifiedFantasyKeys=new HashSet<>();
        for(Map<String,Object> score:realFantasyRows) {
            String key=String.valueOf(score.get("playerKey"));
            if(!verifiedFantasyKeys.add(key))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Fantavoto reale doppio: "+key);
            String identity=approved.get(key);
            if(identity==null)continue;
            Career career=byIdentity.get(identity);
            if(career==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Fantavoto reale fuori cutoff: "+key);
            Map<String,Object> seasonRow=null;
            for(var row:career.seasons)if(key.equals(row.get("playerKey")))seasonRow=row;
            if(seasonRow==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Fantavoto reale senza carriera: "+key);
            int n=asInt(score.get("votiRealiValidi"));
            if(n<=0 || n!=asInt(seasonRow.get("votiValidi")))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Fantavoto reale con denominatore errato: "+key);
            career.verifiedRealFantasyVotes+=n;
            career.verifiedRealFantasySum=career.verifiedRealFantasySum.add(asDecimal(score.get("sommaFantavotiReali")));
            career.verifiedRealRules.add(String.valueOf(score.get("regolamentoFonte")));
            seasonRow.put("fantamediaReale",asDecimal(score.get("sommaFantavotiReali"))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(n),MC));
            seasonRow.put("fantamediaRealeFonte",score.get("regolamentoFonte"));
        }
        List<Map<String,Object>> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(Career c:byIdentity.values()) {
            c.seasons.sort(Comparator.comparing(x->String.valueOf(x.get("stagione"))));
            if(c.seasons.stream().map(s->s.get("stagione")).distinct().count()!=c.seasons.size())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Identita' approvata compare due volte nella stessa stagione: " + c.identityId);
            c.fantasyContexts.sort(Comparator.comparing((Map<String,Object> x)->String.valueOf(x.get("stagione")))
                .thenComparing(x->String.valueOf(x.get("fantasquadra")))
                .thenComparing(x->String.valueOf(x.get("competizione"))));
            if(c.seasons.size()>1) {
                if(selectedIds.contains("TF14") || selectedIds.contains("TF15"))
                    calculateAnomalies(c,settings,selectedIds);
                out.add(c.view());
            }
        }
        out.sort(Comparator.comparing(x->String.valueOf(x.get("playerIdentityId"))));
        return List.copyOf(out);
    }

    /** Leave-one-season-out: the candidate season NEVER appears in its baseline. */
    private static void calculateAnomalies(Career c, TopFlopSettings settings, Set<String> selectedIds) {
        for(Map<String,Object> candidate:c.seasons) {
            int votes=asInt(candidate.get("votiValidi"));
            if(votes<settings.anomalySeasonVotes())continue;
            BigDecimal mean=asDecimal(candidate.get("sommaVoti"))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(votes),MC);
            int baselineVotes=0;
            BigDecimal sum=BigDecimal.ZERO;
            List<String> years=new ArrayList<>();
            for(Map<String,Object> other:c.seasons) {
                if(other==candidate)continue;
                int n=asInt(other.get("votiValidi"));
                if(n<=0)continue;
                baselineVotes+=n;
                sum=sum.add(asDecimal(other.get("sommaVoti")));
                years.add(String.valueOf(other.get("stagione")));
            }
            if(baselineVotes<settings.anomalyBaselineVotes()
                    || years.size()<settings.anomalyBaselineSeasons())continue;
            BigDecimal baseline=sum.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(baselineVotes),MC);
            BigDecimal delta=mean.subtract(baseline);
            String id=delta.signum()>0?"TF14":"TF15";
            if(delta.abs().compareTo(settings.anomalyDelta())<0 || !selectedIds.contains(id))continue;
            c.anomalies.add(Map.ofEntries(Map.entry("recordId",id),
                Map.entry("stagione",String.valueOf(candidate.get("stagione"))),
                Map.entry("playerKey",String.valueOf(candidate.get("playerKey"))),
                Map.entry("votiValidiStagione",votes),Map.entry("mediaStagione",mean),
                Map.entry("votiValidiBaseline",baselineVotes),Map.entry("mediaBaseline",baseline),
                Map.entry("stagioniBaseline",List.copyOf(years)),Map.entry("numeroStagioniBaseline",years.size()),
                Map.entry("delta",delta),Map.entry("sogliaDelta",settings.anomalyDelta()),
                Map.entry("criterio","CONFRONTO_MEDIA_PONDERATA_ESCLUSA_STAGIONE_IN_ESAME")));
        }
        c.anomalies.sort(Comparator.comparing(x->String.valueOf(x.get("stagione"))));
    }

    /** Parse the same audited, compact JS staged by the Java 4.0 exporter. */
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> readCareers(Path directory,List<Path> files) throws IOException {
        List<Map<String,Object>> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(Path source:files) {
            if(!source.getFileName().toString().contains(".Careers."))continue;
            for(Object raw:readRows(directory,source))out.add(decodeCareer(raw));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Real scores come from audited FCA Statistiche or explicitly verified season rulebooks. */
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> readRealFantasy(Path directory,List<Path> files) throws IOException {
        List<Map<String,Object>> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(Path source:files) {
            if(!source.getFileName().toString().contains(".RealFantasy."))continue;
            for(Object raw:readRows(directory,source))out.add(asObject(raw));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Per-season dictionaries are from the scoped 3.2 facade, NEVER guessed by name. */
    public static List<Map<String,Object>> readTeams(Path directory,List<Path> files,
                                                      List<Map<String,Object>> seasonMetadata) throws IOException {
        Map<String,Map<Integer,String>> teamNames=new LinkedHashMap<>(),competitionNames=new LinkedHashMap<>(),
            competitionFamilies=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(Map<String,Object> season:seasonMetadata) {
            String id=String.valueOf(season.get("stagione"));
            Map<String,Object> dict=asObject(season.get("dizionari"));
            Map<Integer,String> teams=new LinkedHashMap<>(),competitions=new LinkedHashMap<>(),families=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for(Object raw:asList(dict.get("squadre"))) {
                List<?> row=asList(raw);
                if(row.size()!=2)throw new IOException("Dizionario squadre non valido: "+id);
                teams.put(asInt(row.get(0)),String.valueOf(row.get(1)));
            }
            for(Object raw:asList(dict.get("competizioni"))) {
                List<?> row=asList(raw);
                if(row.size()!=3)throw new IOException("Dizionario competizioni non valido: "+id);
                competitions.put(asInt(row.get(0)),String.valueOf(row.get(1)));
                families.put(asInt(row.get(0)),String.valueOf(row.get(2)));
            }
            if(teamNames.putIfAbsent(id,teams)!=null)throw new IOException("Stagione duplicata nei dizionari: "+id);
            competitionNames.put(id,competitions);competitionFamilies.put(id,families);
        }
        List<Map<String,Object>> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(Path source:files) {
            if(!source.getFileName().toString().contains(".Teams."))continue;
            for(Object raw:readRows(directory,source)) {
                if(!(raw instanceof List<?> row)|| (row.size()!=4 && row.size()!=5))
                    throw new IOException("Riga Teams non valida in "+source);
                String key=String.valueOf(row.get(0)),season=seasonOf(key);
                int team=asInt(row.get(1)),competition=asInt(row.get(2));
                String teamName=teamNames.getOrDefault(season,Map.of()).get(team);
                String compName=competitionNames.getOrDefault(season,Map.of()).get(competition);
                String family=competitionFamilies.getOrDefault(season,Map.of()).get(competition);
                if(teamName==null||compName==null||family==null)
                    throw new IOException("ID squadra/competizione non risolti: "+key+"/"+team+"/"+competition);
                List<?> usage=asList(row.get(3));
                if(usage.size()<9 || usage.size()>10)
                    throw new IOException("Riga apporto Teams non valida: "+key);
                Map<String,Object> decoded=new LinkedHashMap<>();
                decoded.put("playerKey",key);
                decoded.put("idSquadraInterno",team);decoded.put("idCompetizioneInterno",competition);
                decoded.put("fantasquadra",teamName);decoded.put("competizione",compName);decoded.put("famiglia",family);
                decoded.put("gareConteggiate",usage.get(1));decoded.put("gareConVotoReale",usage.get(2));
                decoded.put("sommaVotiRealiApportati",usage.get(3));
                decoded.put("sommaFantavotiApportati",usage.get(4));
                decoded.put("panchinaNonConteggiata",usage.get(5));decoded.put("fuoriLista",usage.get(6));
                if(usage.size()==10)decoded.put("nonUtilizzatoOsservato",decodeUnused(usage.get(9)));
                if(row.size()==5)decoded.put("costoAcquisto",decodeCost(row.get(4)));
                out.add(decoded);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    private static Map<String,Object> decodeCost(Object raw) throws IOException {
        List<?> r=asList(raw);
        if(r.size()!=4)throw new IOException("Costo FCM non valido");
        int n=asInt(r.get(0));
        if(n<0)throw new IOException("Conteggio costi negativo");
        Map<String,Object> result=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        result.put("registrazioniConCosto",n);
        result.put("minimo",n==0?null:asDecimal(r.get(1)));
        result.put("massimo",n==0?null:asDecimal(r.get(2)));
        result.put("medio",n==0?null:asDecimal(r.get(3)));
        return result;
    }
    private static Map<String,Object> decodeUnused(Object raw) throws IOException {
        List<?> u=asList(raw);
        if(u.size()!=5)throw new IOException("Dettaglio fuori campo non valido");
        int realValid=asInt(u.get(0)),fantasyValid=asInt(u.get(2));
        BigDecimal votes=asDecimal(u.get(1)),fantasy=asDecimal(u.get(3));
        return Map.of("gareConVotoReale",realValid,"sommaVotiReali",votes,
            "mediaVotoReale",realValid==0?"":votes.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(realValid),MC),
            "gareConFantavotoNumerico",fantasyValid,"sommaFantavotiTabellino",fantasy,
            "fantamediaTabellino",fantasyValid==0?"":fantasy.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(fantasyValid),MC),
            "eventiRealiNonApportati",decodeEvents(asList(u.get(4))));
    }
    private static List<?> readRows(Path directory,Path source) throws IOException {
        if(!source.normalize().getParent().equals(directory.normalize()))throw new IOException("Shard fuori dalla directory");
        String js=Files.readString(source,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        int begin=js.indexOf(SHARD_PREFIX),end=js.lastIndexOf("]);})();");
        if(begin<0 || end<begin)throw new IOException("Formato shard non riconosciuto: " + source);
        String body=js.substring(begin+SHARD_PREFIX.length(),end);
        Object parsed=MiniJson.parse("["+body+"]");
        if(!(parsed instanceof List<?> rows))throw new IOException("Shard non-array: " + source);
        return rows;
    }
    private static Map<String,Object> decodeCareer(Object raw) {
        if(raw instanceof Map<?,?>)return asObject(raw); // controlled tests.
        if(!(raw instanceof List<?> r) || (r.size()!=6 && r.size()!=7))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Career compatta non valida: "+raw);
        if(!(r.get(4) instanceof List<?> real) || real.size()!=6)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Aggregato reale non valido");
        Map<String,Object> row=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        row.put("playerKey",r.get(0));row.put("nome",r.get(1));
        row.put("reale",Map.of("votiValidi",real.get(0),"sommaVoti",real.get(1),
            "eventi",decodeEvents(asList(real.get(2)))));
        if(r.size()==7) {
            try {row.put("costoAcquisto",decodeCost(r.get(6)));}
            catch(IOException ex){throw new IllegalArgumentException("Costo Career non valido",ex);}
        }
        return row;
    }
    private static Map<String,Object> decodeEvents(List<?> pairs) {
        if(pairs.size()%2!=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Eventi reali non validi");
        Map<String,Object> events=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(int i=0;i<pairs.size();i+=2) {
            int index=asInt(pairs.get(i));
            if(index<0||index>=EVENTS.size()||events.putIfAbsent(EVENTS.get(index),pairs.get(i+1))!=null)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Codice evento duplicato o fuori range");
        }
        return events;
    }
    private static String seasonOf(String key) {
        String season=key.length()>=9?key.substring(0,9):"";
        if(!season.matches("[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{4}") || key.length()<=10 || key.charAt(9)!=':')
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("PlayerKey non valido: "+key);
        return season;
    }
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<String,Object> asObject(Object raw) {
        if(!(raw instanceof Map<?,?> m))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Formato non-oggetto: " + raw);
        return (Map<String,Object>)m;
    }
    private static List<?> asList(Object raw) {
        if(!(raw instanceof List<?> a))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Formato non-array: "+raw);
        return a;
    }
    private static int asInt(Object raw){if(!(raw instanceof Number n))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contatore mancante");return n.intValue();}
    private static BigDecimal asDecimal(Object raw){if(raw==null)return BigDecimal.ZERO;return new BigDecimal(raw.toString());}
}
~~~~~

~~~~~java
package it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.topflop;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.util.Map;

/** JDK-only tests plus optional SQLite integration using project runtime JDBC driver. */
public final class TopFlopOfficialFmtV58SmokeTest {
    private static void check(boolean condition, String why) {
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(why);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Map<String,Object> correct = TopFlopFcaOfficialFantasy.verifiedRow(
            "2012_2013",4,28,28,new BigDecimal("5.25"));
        check(correct != null, "Official FCA row missing");
        check("2012_2013:4".equals(correct.get("playerKey")), "Wrong player key");
        check(((BigDecimal) correct.get("sommaFantavotiReali")).compareTo(
            new BigDecimal("147.00")) == 0, "Official weighted FMT");
        check(new BigDecimal("5.25").compareTo((BigDecimal)correct.get("fantamediaReale")) == 0,
            "Official FMT cannot be reconstructed from FCM");
        check(TopFlopFcaOfficialFantasy.verifiedRow("2012_2013",4,28,27,
            new BigDecimal("5.259")) == null, "Outdated Storico must not be preferred");
        check(TopFlopFcaOfficialFantasy.verifiedRow("2012_2013",4,28,28,null) == null,
            "Missing FMT is not zero");
        check(TopFlopFcaOfficialFantasy.verifiedRow("2012_2013",4,0,0,
            BigDecimal.ZERO) == null, "No match-vote sample");
        if (args.length == 1) {
            try (var c=DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:"+Path.of(args[0]).toAbsolutePath().toUri()+"?mode=ro")) {
                var loaded=TopFlopJdbcArchiveAssembler.loadSeason(c,"2012_2013");
                var result=TopFlopFcaOfficialFantasy.extract(c,"2012_2013",loaded,null);
                var quality=result.quality();
                check(((Number)quality.get("votiValidiFCA")).intValue()==9936,
                    "Corrected FCA vote total missing");
                check(((Number)quality.get("discordanzePresenzeFCA")).intValue()==0,
                    "FCA Statistiche.PRESENZE not reconciled");
                var abbiati=result.rows().stream().filter(r ->
                    "2012_2013:4".equals(r.get("playerKey"))).findFirst().orElseThrow();
                check(((Number)abbiati.get("votiRealiValidi")).intValue()==28,
                    "2012 Abbiati should have 28 votes");
                check(((BigDecimal)abbiati.get("fantamediaReale")).compareTo(
                    new BigDecimal("5.25"))==0,"2012 FMT must come from official FCA");
                System.out.println("RN4_V58_DB_OK "+quality);
            }
        }
        System.out.println("RN4_V58_FCA_OFFICIAL_FMT_SMOKE_OK");
    }
}
~~~~~

## `src/test/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/app/model/ExecutionPlannerTest.java`

SHA256: `a4eda8f6a7100801bc078aac8ac534ca96bb4c83fd935a1a6c02eb9bdc0e310c`

~~~~~java
package it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.model;



import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;



import java.util.EnumSet;

import java.util.Set;



import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;



class ExecutionPlannerTest {



    @Test

    void legacyCaptainSeriesIsNotPlanned() {

        ProcessingSelection selection = new ProcessingSelection(

                EnumSet.of(RecordFamily.CLASSICS, RecordFamily.SERIES),

                Set.of(),

                false,

                true,

                false

        );



        ExecutionPlan plan = ExecutionPlanner.plan(

                selection,

                DependencyInventory.legacyCapabilities(false, true, true, false)

        );



        assertFalse(plan.items().stream()

                .anyMatch(item -> item.child().id().equals("series.captain-bonus")));

        assertTrue(plan.items().stream()

                .anyMatch(item -> item.child().id().equals("classics.highest-match-score")));

    }



    @Test

    void culometroRemainsNotSelectedByDefault() {

        ProcessingSelection selection = new ProcessingSelection(

                EnumSet.of(RecordFamily.THRESHOLDS_LUCK),

                Set.of(),

                false,

                true,

                false

        );



        ExecutionPlan plan = ExecutionPlanner.plan(

                selection,

                DependencyInventory.legacyCapabilities(false, true, true, true)

        );



        ExecutionPlanItem culometro = plan.items().stream()

                .filter(item -> item.child().id().equals(CoreRecordCatalog.CULOMETRO_ID))

                .findFirst()

                .orElseThrow();



        assertEquals(OutputStatus.SKIPPED_NOT_SELECTED, culometro.status());

    }



    @Test

    void explicitCulometroCanBePlanned() {

        ProcessingSelection selection = new ProcessingSelection(

                EnumSet.of(RecordFamily.THRESHOLDS_LUCK),

                Set.of(CoreRecordCatalog.CULOMETRO_ID),

                true,

                true,

                false

        );



        ExecutionPlan plan = ExecutionPlanner.plan(

                selection,

                DependencyInventory.legacyCapabilities(false, true, true, true)

        );



        assertTrue(plan.executableItems().stream()

                .anyMatch(item -> item.child().id().equals(CoreRecordCatalog.CULOMETRO_ID)));

        assertFalse(plan.hasFailures());

    }



    @Test

    void planGroupsItemsByFamily() {

        ProcessingSelection selection = new ProcessingSelection(

                EnumSet.allOf(RecordFamily.class),

                Set.of(),

                false,

                true,

                false

        );



        ExecutionPlan plan = ExecutionPlanner.plan(

                selection,

                DependencyInventory.legacyCapabilities(false, true, false, false)

        );



        assertEquals(java.util.EnumSet.allOf(RecordFamily.class), plan.byFamily().keySet());

    }

}
~~~~~

## `docs/VERIFICA_FANTAMEDIA_REALE_FCA_v58.md`

SHA256: `2a92ca266372024e024202091cf64b5212aceb8f11d663b4a32f6c670d16c6db`

~~~~~markdown
# RecordsNext 4.0 - v58: fonte ufficiale FMT FCA per le viste Top & Flop

## Scopo e limitazioni

Questo intervento modifica unicamente l'estrazione `RealFantasy` per le viste
Top & Flop e la stringa di disponibilita' della scheda storica. Non modifica
la fonte FCA/FCM, l'SQLite, il motore dei record classici 3.2, il sistema di
identita' o i punteggi apportati dalle fantasquadre (FCM Tabellino.TOT).

## Algoritmo

- Leggere i dati ufficiali `raw_..._fca_statistiche`: `FMT` e `PRESENZE`.
- Per ciascun calciatore confrontare `Statistiche.PRESENZE` con
  `COUNT(GiocaIn JOIN Punteggio WHERE VOTO1 > 0)` della stessa stagione.
- Accettare `FMT` ufficiale solo con voto positivo, campione esattamente
  corrispondente e FMT valida; mai sostituire dati mancanti con zero.
- Esportare il campione, la fonte e lo stato. La `sommaFantavotiReali` e'
  `FMT*PRESENZE` ed e' una ricostruzione ponderata a partire dalla media
  stagionale ARROTONDATA della fonte FCA, non la somma dei singoli fantavoti.
- Se un regolamento stagionale e' stato verificato e registrato esplicitamente,
  la ricostruzione da eventi viene usata SOLO per gli eventuali calciatori
  privi di una FMT ufficiale allineata, senza inventare coefficienti.
- Non usare `Storico.FANTAMEDIA1` come sostituto automatico: nel 2012/13
  la sua copertura e' ferma alle giornate 2-38 (v57).
- Non fondere identita' tra stagioni per nome o codice storico.

## Prove prima del rilascio

1. `TopFlopOfficialFmtV58SmokeTest`: test aritmetici + confronto SQLite
   2012/13, con voti 9936, Abbiati 28 e `FMT=5.25`.
2. Compilazione e test del progetto con Maven nella copia TEST.
3. Rigenerazione Completa da GUI, pubblicazione DISABILITATA.
4. Verifica dei nove JS base compatibili 3.2 + facades Top & Flop,
   shard, hash, limite fisico di 1.500.000 byte per singolo JS.
5. Audit confrontando ogni RealFantasy ufficiale pubblicata nel nuovo staging
   con Statistiche.FMT/PRESENZE e count VOTO1 effettivo.
6. Solo successivamente: prova di pubblicazione multisito in sandbox,
   integrazione visualizzatori, cutoff storico, e collaudo navigazione.

## Stato

Patch TEST non equivale a release finale. Non pubblicare nei siti reali
prima dei test di sandbox e dell'approvazione esplicita dell'utente.

## Correzione v58c del test planner

`ExecutionPlannerTest.planGroupsItemsByFamily` verificava erroneamente cinque
famiglie. Il catalogo comprende sei famiglie, inclusa `TOP_FLOP`, e
`ExecutionPlan.byFamily()` restituisce un raggruppamento per ciascuna.
La correzione **non sostituisce il file con il vecchio v46**: modifica
soltanto l'asserzione nel file di TEST installato, verificando prima il suo
SHA-256 e conservando tutto il resto. L'asserzione risultante confronta
le famiglie pianificate con tutte le famiglie di `RecordFamily`.
Nessuna logica del planner viene alterata. Maven v58 falliva su un test
obsoleto (1 fallimento su 58).
~~~~~

~~~~~python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only validation of actual Java publisher output inside TEST sandbox v52.
Does not claim that HTML has been inspected in a browser.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

ROOT=Path(r'D:\DEV_APPS\RecordsNext4.0_TEST_v37')
SITES=ROOT/'data/publish-sandbox-v52/sites'
STATE=ROOT/'data/publish-sandbox-v52/state.json'
REPORTS=Path(r'D:\DEV_APPS\downloads')
LIMIT=1_500_000
FACADES=('Core','Classics','Series','RU','Modifiers','ThresholdsLuck','Culometro','Matches','Manifest')
NAME=re.compile(r'^fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews\.(Careers|Teams|Records|Highlights|Economy|RealFantasy|Bench)\.\d{4}_\d{4}\.\d{3}\.js$')

def require(ok,msg):
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError(msg)

def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def facade(p):
    t=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    a=t.find('{');b=t.rfind('};')
    require(a>=0 and b>a,'Facade TopFlop invalida: '+str(p))
    return json.loads(t[a:b+1])

def verify():
    require(STATE.is_file(),'Sandbox v52 non preparata: state.json mancante')
    state=json.loads(STATE.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    require(state.get('schema')=='rn4-publish-sandbox-v52','Schema sandbox inatteso')
    require(state.get('root','').casefold()==str(ROOT).casefold(),'Sandbox di diversa installazione')
    ids=state['selected']
    require(ids and len(ids)==len(set(ids)),'Stagioni selezionate nulle o duplicate')
    require(set(state['sites'])==set(state['original']),'Manifest sandbox incoerente: siti/origini')
    require(all(s in state['sites'] and state['original'][s] is not None for s in ids),'Stagione selezionata senza sito originario')
    require(SITES.is_dir(),'Siti sandbox non trovati')
    details=[];errors=[]
    for sid in ids:
        path=Path(state['sites'][sid]); js=path/'js'
        # Refuse any route back to the production site.
        require(path.resolve().is_relative_to(SITES.resolve()),'Percorso fuori sandbox: '+str(path))
        require(js.is_dir(),'Cartella JS mancante: '+sid)
        js_files=list(js.glob('fcmRecordsNext_*.js'))
        oversize=[(p.name,p.stat().st_size) for p in js_files if not (0<p.stat().st_size<=LIMIT)]
        if oversize:errors.append({'season':sid,'oversize':oversize[:10]})
        missing=[name for name in FACADES if not (js/('fcmRecordsNext_'+name+'.js')).is_file()]
        if missing:errors.append({'season':sid,'missing_facades':missing})
        tf=js/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews.js'
        if not tf.is_file():
            errors.append({'season':sid,'missing_tf_facade':True})
            details.append({'season':sid,'js_count':len(js_files),'max_bytes':max((p.stat().st_size for p in js_files),default=0),'tf_shards':0,'tf_seasons':0})
            continue
        meta=facade(tf);seasons=meta.get('stagioni') or []
        if not seasons:errors.append({'season':sid,'tf_seasons_empty':True})
        if any(str(x.get('stagione',''))>sid for x in seasons):
            errors.append({'season':sid,'historical_cutoff_violated':True})
        tf_count=0;present=set()
        for season in seasons:
            s=season.get('stagione')
            if not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}_\d{4}',str(s)):
                errors.append({'season':sid,'bad_season_id':s});continue
            for item in season.get('files') or []:
                fn=item.get('nome','')
                if not NAME.fullmatch(fn):
                    errors.append({'season':sid,'bad_filename':fn});continue
                dest=js/fn
                if not dest.is_file():
                    errors.append({'season':sid,'shard_missing':fn});continue
                if dest.stat().st_size!=item.get('byte'):
                    errors.append({'season':sid,'shard_size_mismatch':fn});continue
                if sha(dest).lower()!=str(item.get('sha256','')).lower():
                    errors.append({'season':sid,'shard_hash_mismatch':fn});continue
                tf_count+=1;present.add((s,fn.split('.')[1]))
        if sid>='2012_2013' and ('2012_2013','RealFantasy') not in present:
            errors.append({'season':sid,'real_fantasy_2012_missing':True})
        details.append({'season':sid,'js_count':len(js_files),
                        'max_bytes':max((p.stat().st_size for p in js_files),default=0),
                        'tf_shards':tf_count,'tf_seasons':len(seasons)})
    return {'status':'SANDBOX_VERIFICATA_NON_RELEASE' if not errors else 'BLOCCATO',
            'generated_at':dt.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
            'selected_seasons':len(ids),'configured_seasons':sum(v is not None for v in state['original'].values()),
            'manual_unconfigured_seasons':sorted(s for s,v in state['original'].items() if v is None),
            'unselected_seasons':sorted(s for s,v in state['original'].items() if v is not None and s not in ids),
            'total_js':sum(d['js_count'] for d in details),
            'max_bytes':max((d['max_bytes'] for d in details),default=0),
            'sites':details,'errors':errors,
            'notes':['Verifica della pubblicazione effettiva da GUI; non certifica rendering browser.',
                     'Le stagioni non selezionate non possono essere dichiarate pubblicate.']}

def main():
    REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    out=REPORTS/('RN4_MULTISITO_GATE_v60_'+dt.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')+'.json')
    try:
        x=verify();code=0 if not x['errors'] else 2
        print('MULTISITO v60:',x['status'],'| selezionate:',x['selected_seasons'],'/',x['configured_seasons'])
        print('JS sandbox:',x['total_js'],'| massimo:',x['max_bytes'],'byte')
        if x['unselected_seasons']:
            print('DA PUBBLICARE SU SANDBOX (NON SELEZIONATE):',', '.join(x['unselected_seasons']))
        for r in x['sites']:
            print(r['season'],'JS',r['js_count'],'TF shard',r['tf_shards'],'TF cutoff',r['tf_seasons'])
        if x['errors']:
            for e in x['errors'][:15]:print('ERRORE',e)
    except Exception as ex:
        x={'status':'BLOCCATO','error':str(ex)};code=2
        print('MULTISITO BLOCCATO:',ex)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')
    print('RAPPORTO:',out)
    return code

if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())
~~~~~

## `D:\DEV_APPS\downloads\RN4_SANDBOX_RELEASE_v60b\tools\v52\Prepara-Pubblicazione-Test-v52.py`

SHA256: `cde66ff06de4063ba726c2da6ef2fc78c93a269d145f492ecef479fb45161db0`

~~~~~python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RecordsNext 4.0 isolated website publication sandbox.

Only edits the TEST database and TEST properties. The real FCM/3.2 installations
are read-only sources for copying frontend assets. All SQLite site targets are
redirected to isolated TEST directories before GUI publication is enabled.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import stat
import sys

DEFAULT_ROOT = r'D:\DEV_APPS\RecordsNext4.0_TEST_v37'
SANDBOX_NAME = 'publish-sandbox-v52'
CLONE_SEASONS = ('2025_2026','2026_2027')
LIMIT = 1_500_000
SEASON_ID = re.compile(r'^\d{4}_\d{4}$')


def must(ok: bool, msg: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(msg)


def read_props(p: Path) -> dict[str,str]:
    out={}
    for ln in p.read_text(encoding='latin-1').splitlines():
        ln=ln.strip()
        if not ln or ln[0] in '#!':continue
        m=re.match(r'^([^\s=:]+)\s*[=:]\s*(.*)$',ln)
        if not m:continue
        val=m.group(2)
        val=re.sub(r'\\([:=\\])',lambda x:x.group(1),val)
        out[m.group(1)]=val
    return out


def update_props(p: Path, updates: dict[str,str]):
    lines=p.read_text(encoding='latin-1').splitlines(keepends=True)
    seen=set();new=[]
    for line in lines:
        m=re.match(r'^\s*([^\s=:]+)\s*[=:]',line)
        if m and m.group(1) in updates:
            k=m.group(1)
            if k not in seen:
                value=str(updates[k]).replace('\\','/').replace(':','\\:')
                new.append(k+'='+value+'\n');seen.add(k)
        else:new.append(line)
    for k,v in updates.items():
        if k not in seen:new.append(k+'='+str(v).replace('\\','/').replace(':','\\:')+'\n')
    p.write_text(''.join(new),encoding='latin-1')


def sha(p: Path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def is_reparse(p:Path)->bool:
    try:
        st=p.lstat()
        return p.is_symlink() or bool(getattr(st,'st_file_attributes',0) & getattr(stat,'FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT',0x400))
    except OSError:return True


def copied_site(source: Path, target: Path):
    must(source.is_dir(),f'Sito frontend non trovato: {source}')
    must(not is_reparse(source),f'Cartella sito con collegamento/reparse: {source}')
    must(not target.exists(),f'Destinazione gia presente: {target}')
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    skip={'count':0}
    def ignore(d,names):
        bad=[]
        for n in names:
            p=Path(d)/n
            if is_reparse(p):bad.append(n);skip['count']+=1
        return bad
    tmp=target.with_name(target.name+'.copying')
    must(not tmp.exists(),f'Copia incompleta precedente: {tmp}')
    try:
        shutil.copytree(source,tmp,ignore=ignore,copy_function=shutil.copy2)
        (tmp/'js').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        tmp.rename(target)
    except BaseException:
        if tmp.exists():shutil.rmtree(tmp)
        raise
    return skip['count']


def db_rows(db:Path):
    with sqlite3.connect(db.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as c:
        cols={x[1] for x in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(rn_season_configuration)')}
        must({'season_id','local_site_path'}.issubset(cols),'Schema SQLite inatteso')
        rows=dict(c.execute('''SELECT s.season_id,c.local_site_path FROM rn_season s
                              LEFT JOIN rn_season_configuration c ON s.season_id=c.season_id'''))
    return rows


def scope(root:Path):
    root=root.resolve()
    must('TEST' in root.name.upper(),f'RIFIUTATO: root non TEST: {root}')
    must(root.is_dir(),'Root TEST inesistente')
    config=root/'config';db=root/'data'/'database'/'recordsnext.db'
    props=config/'recordsnext-gui.properties';processing=config/'processing.json'
    for p in [db,props,processing,config/'player-identities.json',config/'topflop.json']:
        must(p.is_file(),f'File TEST obbligatorio assente: {p}')
    j=json.loads(processing.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    must(j.get('processing',{}).get('output',{}).get('publishToSite') is False,
         'BLOCCO: processing.output.publishToSite deve essere false')
    pr=read_props(props)
    must(pr.get('processing.publish')=='false',
         'BLOCCO: processing.publish deve essere false. Chiudere la GUI e ripristinarlo prima della preparazione.')
    rows=db_rows(db)
    selected=[s.strip() for s in pr.get('seasons','').split(',') if s.strip()]
    must(bool(selected),'Nessuna stagione selezionata')
    must(all(SEASON_ID.fullmatch(s) for s in rows),'ID stagione non valido nel DB')
    must(set(selected).issubset(rows),'Una stagione selezionata non e nel DB')
    must(rows.get('2026_2027') and rows.get('2025_2026'),
         'Siti 2025/26 e 2026/27 non configurati nel DB TEST')
    work=root/'data'/SANDBOX_NAME
    return dict(root=root,config=config,db=db,props=props,processing=processing,
                pr=pr,rows=rows,selected=selected,work=work)


def print_plan(a):
    print('TEST:',a['root'])
    print('STAGIONI DB:',len(a['rows']),'SELEZIONATE:',len(a['selected']))
    print('SITO 2025/26 (corrente selezionato):',a['rows'].get('2025_2026'))
    print('SITO 2026/27 (non ancora selezionato):',a['rows'].get('2026_2027'))
    print('SANDBOX:',a['work'])
    print('CLONI FRONTEND:',', '.join(CLONE_SEASONS))
    print('ALTRE STAGIONI: destinazioni JS isolate, senza copiare i siti completi')
    print('NESSUNA MODIFICA ai siti E:, alla 3.2 e alle identita')


def apply(root:Path):
    a=scope(root);print_plan(a)
    work=a['work']
    must(not work.exists(),f'Sandbox gia presente: {work}. Usare --verify oppure --audit.')
    must(all(a['rows'].get(s) for s in a['selected']),
         'Destinazione originale mancante per una stagione attiva; verificare il DB')
    # Copia dei siti PRIMA di qualsiasi cambio al DB; in caso di errore il DB resta invariato.
    sites=work/'sites'
    try:
        for sid,src in sorted(a['rows'].items()):
            tgt=sites/sid
            if sid in CLONE_SEASONS:
                skipped=copied_site(Path(src),tgt)
                print('COPIA SITO',sid,'->',tgt,'reparse saltati=',skipped,flush=True)
            else:
                (tgt/'js').mkdir(parents=True)
        backup=work/'backup';backup.mkdir()
        with sqlite3.connect(a['db']) as source, sqlite3.connect(backup/'recordsnext.db') as dest:
            source.backup(dest)
        for p in [a['props'],a['processing'],a['config']/'player-identities.json',a['config']/'topflop.json',a['config']/'league.json']:
            if p.exists():shutil.copy2(p,backup/p.name)
        state={'schema':'rn4-publish-sandbox-v52','original':a['rows'],
               'selected':a['selected'], 'created':datetime.now().isoformat(),
               'root':str(a['root']),'sites':{s:str(sites/s) for s in a['rows']},
               'protectedHash':{n:sha(a['config']/n) for n in ('player-identities.json','topflop.json')}}
        (work/'state.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
        try:
            with sqlite3.connect(a['db'],timeout=5) as c:
                c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
                for sid in a['rows']:
                    c.execute('UPDATE rn_season_configuration SET local_site_path=? WHERE season_id=?',
                              (str(sites/sid),sid))
                c.commit()
            current=sites/'2026_2027'
            update_props(a['props'],{
                'processing.publish':'false', 'publish.destinationMode':'custom',
                'publish.customDirectory':str(current/'js'), 'siteJs':str(current/'js'),
                'chooser.lastSiteDirectory':str(current)})
            verify(root)
        except BaseException:
            # Ritorno immediato: ripristino solo i percorsi delle destinazioni e le properties.
            with sqlite3.connect(a['db'],timeout=5) as c:
                c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
                for sid,old in a['rows'].items():
                    c.execute('UPDATE rn_season_configuration SET local_site_path=? WHERE season_id=?',(old,sid))
                c.commit()
            shutil.copy2(backup/'recordsnext-gui.properties',a['props'])
            raise
    except BaseException:
        print('ERRORE: preparazione non completata. Verificare la sandbox; nessun sito E: scritto.',file=sys.stderr)
        raise
    print('\nSANDBOX PRONTA - NON ANCORA PUBBLICATA')
    print('Usare nella GUI SOLO il pulsante: Pubblica i siti delle stagioni selezionate')
    if '2026_2027' not in a['selected']:
        print('NOTA: 2026/27 non selezionata, la copia di Lega2026 NON sara pubblicata ora.')


def load_state(root:Path):
    work=root/'data'/SANDBOX_NAME
    p=work/'state.json'
    must(p.is_file(),'Sandbox non preparata: '+str(p))
    st=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    must(st.get('schema')=='rn4-publish-sandbox-v52' and st.get('root')==str(root),
         'Manifest sandbox incoerente')
    return st


def verify(root:Path):
    """Fail closed: all publishable/selected sites must stay isolated.

    Manual, unselected seasons that never had a configured site (e.g.
    2005_2006) legitimately have NULL local_site_path and are not targets.
    """
    root=root.resolve();must('TEST' in root.name.upper(),'Root non TEST')
    st=load_state(root);sites=root/'data'/SANDBOX_NAME/'sites'
    rows=db_rows(root/'data'/'database'/'recordsnext.db')
    selected=st.get('selected')
    must(isinstance(selected,list) and selected and len(selected)==len(set(selected)),
         'Stagioni selezionate mancanti/duplicate nel manifest')
    must(set(rows)==set(st['sites'])==set(st['original']),
         'Configurazioni DB cambiate rispetto alla sandbox')
    must(set(selected).issubset(rows),
         'Manifest contiene stagioni selezionate non presenti nel DB')
    missing=[];configured=0
    for sid,v in rows.items():
        target=(sites/sid).resolve()
        must(target.is_relative_to(sites.resolve()),'Percorso sandbox non valido: '+sid)
        must(Path(st['sites'][sid]).resolve()==target,
             'Manifest sito incoerente: '+sid)
        if v is None:
            must(sid not in selected and st['original'][sid] is None,
                 'STOP: stagione selezionata/configurata senza destinazione: '+sid)
            missing.append(sid)
            continue
        must(bool(v) and Path(v).resolve()==target,
             'STOP: target fuori sandbox: '+sid+' -> '+str(v))
        must(target.is_dir() and (target/'js').is_dir(),
             'Cartella sandbox assente: '+sid)
        configured+=1
    cfg=root/'config'
    for n,expected in st['protectedHash'].items():
        must(sha(cfg/n)==expected,'PROTETTO MODIFICATO: '+n)
    props=read_props(cfg/'recordsnext-gui.properties')
    actual_selected=[s.strip() for s in props.get('seasons','').split(',') if s.strip()]
    must(len(actual_selected)==len(set(actual_selected)) and set(actual_selected)==set(selected),
         'STAGIONI GUI CAMBIATE: selezione diversa dalla preparazione sandbox')
    must(props.get('processing.publish')=='false',
         'Pubblicazione automatica GUI deve restare disabilitata')
    processing=json.loads((cfg/'processing.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    must(processing.get('processing',{}).get('output',{}).get('publishToSite') is False,
         'Pubblicazione automatica processing.json deve restare disabilitata')
    must(props.get('publish.destinationMode')=='custom',
         'Modalita destinazione non custom: blocco preventivo')
    for key in ('siteJs','publish.customDirectory'):
        value=props.get(key)
        must(value and Path(value).resolve().is_relative_to(sites.resolve()),
             'ATTENZIONE: '+key+' punta fuori dalla sandbox: '+str(value))
    print('VERIFICA ISOLAMENTO OK:',configured,'destinazioni pubblicabili in sandbox')
    if missing:
        print('STAGIONI MANUALI SENZA DESTINAZIONE (NON SELEZIONATE):',', '.join(sorted(missing)))
    print('Identita e topflop SHA-256 invariati; nessun target operativo E:')


def audit(root:Path):
    verify(root)
    st=load_state(root.resolve())
    report={'sandbox':str(root/'data'/SANDBOX_NAME),'selected':st['selected'],
            'sites':[],'errors':[]}
    for sid in st['selected']:
        site=Path(st['sites'][sid])/'js'
        files=list(site.glob('fcmRecordsNext*.js'))
        bad=[{'name':p.name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in files if p.stat().st_size>LIMIT]
        if bad:report['errors'].append({'season':sid,'oversize':bad})
        report['sites'].append({'season':sid,'recordJs':len(files),'maxBytes':max((f.stat().st_size for f in files),default=0)})
    output=root/'reports'/'publish-sandbox-v52.json';output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')
    print('REPORT:',output)
    for item in report['sites']:print(item['season'],'JS=',item['recordJs'],'MAX=',item['maxBytes'])
    must(not report['errors'],'STOP: file > 1500000 byte')
    missing=[r['season'] for r in report['sites'] if r['recordJs']==0]
    must(not missing,'PUBBLICAZIONE INCOMPLETA: nessun JS RecordsNext per '+', '.join(missing))
    print('AUDIT OK: tutte le stagioni selezionate hanno output RecordsNext sotto 1500000 byte')


def restore(root:Path):
    root=root.resolve();st=load_state(root)
    work=root/'data'/SANDBOX_NAME
    props=root/'config'/'recordsnext-gui.properties'
    db=root/'data'/'database'/'recordsnext.db'
    with sqlite3.connect(db,timeout=5) as c:
        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
        for sid,old in st['original'].items():
            c.execute('UPDATE rn_season_configuration SET local_site_path=? WHERE season_id=?',(old,sid))
        c.commit()
    shutil.copy2(work/'backup'/'recordsnext-gui.properties',props)
    shutil.copy2(work/'backup'/'processing.json',root/'config'/'processing.json')
    print('DESTINAZIONI ORIGINALI RIPRISTINATE in TEST; sito clone conservato:',work)
    print('Identita/TopFlop/archivi e siti E: intatti.')


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--root',default=DEFAULT_ROOT)
    gr=parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    gr.add_argument('--plan',action='store_true')
    gr.add_argument('--apply',action='store_true')
    gr.add_argument('--verify',action='store_true')
    gr.add_argument('--audit',action='store_true')
    gr.add_argument('--restore',action='store_true')
    opts=parser.parse_args();root=Path(opts.root)
    if opts.plan:print_plan(scope(root))
    elif opts.apply:apply(root)
    elif opts.verify:verify(root)
    elif opts.audit:audit(root)
    elif opts.restore:restore(root)

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as ex:
        print('ERRORE:',ex,file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
~~~~~

~~~~~python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""v59. Audit read-only of newly generated v58c RN4 JS, real FCA FMT and classic facade contract.
Writes only timestamped reports into D:/DEV_APPS/downloads. Never publishes.
"""
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
from decimal import Decimal
from urllib.parse import quote

ROOT=Path(r'D:\DEV_APPS\RecordsNext4.0_TEST_v37')
DEST=Path(r'D:\DEV_APPS\downloads')
LIMIT=1500000
CLASSIC_FACADES=('Core','Classics','Series','RU','Modifiers','ThresholdsLuck','Culometro','Matches','Manifest')
SEASON_RE=re.compile(r'^\d{4}_\d{4}$')


def req(cond, why):
    if not cond: raise RuntimeError(why)


def decode_facade(p):
    txt=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    a=txt.find('{'); b=txt.rfind('};')
    req(a>=0 and b>a, 'Facade TopFlop non JSON: '+str(p))
    return json.loads(txt[a:b+1])


def decode_rows(p):
    s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    mark='a.push(...['
    pos=s.find(mark)
    req(pos>=0,'Shard RealFantasy in formato sconosciuto: '+str(p))
    rows,end=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s[pos+len('a.push(...'):])
    req(isinstance(rows,list), 'Shard JSON non lista: '+str(p))
    return rows


def open_ro(path):
    return sqlite3.connect('file:'+quote(str(path.resolve()).replace('\\','/'),safe='/:')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)


def inspect():
    db=ROOT/'data/database/recordsnext.db'
    docs=ROOT/'docs/CODICE_FUNZIONANTE_RECORDSNEXT4_v44.md'
    req(db.is_file(),'DB TEST mancante')
    req(docs.is_file(),'Bibbia v44 non installata: verificare la v58c')
    processing=json.loads((ROOT/'config/processing.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    req(processing['processing']['output']['publishToSite'] is False,
        'Pubblicazione nel sito ATTIVA! Bloccare e salvare dalla GUI.')
    props=(ROOT/'config/recordsnext-gui.properties').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    req(re.search(r'^processing\.publish=false\s*$',props,re.M) is not None,
        'Checkbox pubblicazione GUI attiva o non verificabile')
    staging=ROOT/'data/site-export-staging'
    candidates=sorted((p/'js' for p in staging.glob('records2026_*') if (p/'js').is_dir()),
                       key=lambda p:(p.stat().st_mtime,p.as_posix()),reverse=True)
    req(bool(candidates),'Nessuno staging: eseguire Completa senza pubblicazione')
    js=candidates[0]
    # The installed release candidate is v58c; the v58 install log was never produced.
    # Do not accept an old/failed installer report as evidence of a successful update.
    installed=sorted(DEST.glob('RN4_V58C_INSTALL_ESITO_*.json'))
    req(bool(installed),'Report installazione v58c assente: non usare il gate v58')
    install_report=installed[-1]
    install=json.loads(install_report.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    req(install.get('status') == 'TEST_PATCH_INSTALLED_NOT_RELEASED',
        'Il report di installazione v58c non certifica un esito positivo')
    req(Path(install.get('root','')).resolve() == ROOT.resolve(),
        'Il report v58c appartiene a una diversa installazione')
    req(install.get('bible') == 'docs/CODICE_FUNZIONANTE_RECORDSNEXT4_v44.md',
        'Il report v58c non corrisponde alla Bibbia v44')
    jar=ROOT/'target/RecordsNext.jar'
    req(jar.is_file(), 'JAR TEST mancante')
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with jar.open('rb') as fh:
        for block in iter(lambda:fh.read(1024*1024),b''):
            h.update(block)
    digest=h.hexdigest()
    req(digest.lower() == str(install.get('jarSHA256','')).lower(),
        'Il JAR attuale e diverso da quello collaudato dalla v58c')
    stamp=install.get('installedAt')
    req(isinstance(stamp,str), 'Timestamp installazione v58c assente')
    install_time=dt.datetime.fromisoformat(stamp).timestamp()
    req(js.stat().st_mtime>install_time,
        'Lo staging precede la patch v58c! Eseguire COMPLETA dalla GUI senza pubblicazione.')
    scripts=sorted(js.glob('fcmRecordsNext_*.js'))
    req(len(scripts)>=339,'JS insufficienti rispetto alla Completa v58c (339): '+str(len(scripts)))
    req(len({s.name for s in scripts})==len(scripts),'Nomi JS ripetuti')
    sizes=[(x.name,x.stat().st_size) for x in scripts]
    big=[x for x in sizes if x[1]>LIMIT or x[1]<=0]
    req(not big,'JS vuoti o fuori limite 1.500.000: '+str(big[:10]))
    for f in CLASSIC_FACADES:
        req((js/('fcmRecordsNext_'+f+'.js')).is_file(),'Manca facade 3.2: '+f)
    facade=js/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews.js'
    req(facade.is_file(),'Manca facade Top & Flop')
    meta=decode_facade(facade)
    seasons=meta.get('stagioni') or []
    req(len(seasons)==21,'Attese 21 stagioni nella facade TF: '+str(len(seasons)))
    req(len({s['stagione'] for s in seasons})==len(seasons),'Stagioni duplicate in facade TF')
    with open_ro(db) as c:
        source=c.execute("select source_path from rn_import where season_id='2012_2013' and source_type='FCA' and status='COMPLETED' order by import_id desc limit 1").fetchone()
        req(source and 'G1_RECUPERATA' in source[0], 'Import FCA 2012/13 corretto non trovato')
        report={'status':'STAGING_VERIFICATO_NON_RELEASE','js_dir':str(js),
                'js_count':len(scripts),'js_max_bytes':max(s for _,s in sizes),
                'installer_version':'v58c','installer_report':str(install_report),
                'jar_sha256':digest,
                'classic_facades':list(CLASSIC_FACADES),
                'tf_seasons':len(seasons),'tf_files_checked':0,
                'fmt_seasons':[], 'warnings':[], 'publish':0}
        for season in seasons:
            sn=season.get('stagione')
            req(isinstance(sn,str) and SEASON_RE.fullmatch(sn),'ID stagione non valido: '+str(sn))
            pfx='raw_'+sn+'_fca_'
            datasets=season.get('files') or []
            data_by_kind={}
            for info in datasets:
                name=info.get('nome','')
                req(re.fullmatch(r'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews\.(Careers|Teams|Records|Highlights|Economy|RealFantasy|Bench)\.'+sn+r'\.\d{3}\.js',name) is not None,
                    'Nome shard non valido: '+name)
                file=js/name
                req(file.is_file(),'Shard mancante: '+name)
                raw=file.read_bytes()
                req(len(raw)==info.get('byte'),'Dimensione non coerente: '+name)
                req(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().lower()==str(info.get('sha256','')).lower(),
                    'SHA256 non coerente: '+name)
                report['tf_files_checked']+=1
                if '.RealFantasy.' in name:
                    rows=decode_rows(file)
                    data_by_kind.setdefault('RealFantasy',[]).extend(rows)
            data=data_by_kind.get('RealFantasy',[])
            req(len(data)>0, 'RealFantasy ancora vuoto per '+sn+'; patch non attiva?')
            source_rows=c.execute(f'''SELECT a.ID, s.PRESENZE, s.FMT, COALESCE(raw.n,0)
            FROM "{pfx}giocatorea" a
            LEFT JOIN "{pfx}statistiche" s ON s.ID=a.ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT g.IDGIOCATORE pid, SUM(CASE WHEN p.VOTO1>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n
            FROM "{pfx}giocain" g JOIN "{pfx}punteggio" p ON p.ID=g.IDPUNTEGGIO
            GROUP BY g.IDGIOCATORE) raw ON raw.pid=a.ID''').fetchall()
            expect={sn+':'+str(pid):(n,Decimal(str(fmt))) for pid,pres,fmt,n in source_rows
                    if n>0 and pres==n and fmt is not None and Decimal(str(fmt))>0}
            emitted={}
            for rec in data:
                key=rec.get('playerKey')
                req(isinstance(key,str) and key.startswith(sn+':'), 'RealFantasy playerKey errato')
                req(key not in emitted,'RealFantasy duplicata: '+key)
                emitted[key]=rec
                if rec.get('regolamentoFonte')=='FCA.Statistiche.FMT':
                    req(key in expect,'FMT ufficiale pubblicata con presenze discordanti: '+key)
                    n,fmt=expect[key]
                    req(int(rec['votiRealiValidi'])==n, 'Campione FMT errato: '+key)
                    req(abs(Decimal(str(rec['fantamediaReale']))-fmt)<Decimal('0.0000001'),
                        'FMT pubblicata diversa dalla fonte FCA: '+key)
                    req(abs(Decimal(str(rec['sommaFantavotiReali']))-fmt*n)<Decimal('0.000001'),
                        'Somma ponderata non coerente: '+key)
            missing=set(expect)-set(emitted)
            req(not missing,'FMT ufficiali mancanti: '+sn+' '+str(sorted(missing)[:5]))
            if sn=='2012_2013':
                total=c.execute(f'''select count(*) from "{pfx}giocain" g join "{pfx}punteggio" p on p.ID=g.IDPUNTEGGIO where p.VOTO1>0''').fetchone()[0]
                g1=c.execute(f'''select count(*) from "{pfx}giocain" g join "{pfx}punteggio" p on p.ID=g.IDPUNTEGGIO where p.VOTO1>0 and g.GIORNATA=1''').fetchone()[0]
                req((total,g1)==(9936,255), 'FCA 2012/13 incompleto '+str((total,g1)))
                req('2012_2013:4' in emitted,'Abbiati FMT mancante')
                req(abs(Decimal(str(emitted['2012_2013:4']['fantamediaReale']))-Decimal('5.25'))<Decimal('0.0000001'),
                    '2012 Abbiati FMT non ufficiale')
                report['fca_2012_votes']=total
                report['fca_2012_g1_votes']=g1
            report['fmt_seasons'].append({'season':sn,'source_rows':len(expect),
                  'published_rows':len(data),'official_rows':sum(x.get('regolamentoFonte')=='FCA.Statistiche.FMT' for x in data)})
    return report


def main():
    DEST.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    stamp=dt.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    dest=DEST/('RN4_RELEASE_GATE_v59_'+stamp+'.json')
    try:
        result=inspect()
        print('GATE v59 STAGING OK | JS:',result['js_count'],'| Max bytes:',result['js_max_bytes'])
        print('Facade 3.2:',len(result['classic_facades']),'| TF:',result['tf_seasons'],'stagioni')
        print('FMT FCA verificate:',sum(x['official_rows'] for x in result['fmt_seasons']))
        print('2012/13:',result['fca_2012_votes'],'voti | G1:',result['fca_2012_g1_votes'])
        print('PROSSIMO GATE: isolamento e pubblicazione multisito nella sandbox, poi collaudo visualizzatori')
        code=0
    except Exception as ex:
        result={'status':'BLOCCATO','error':str(ex)}
        print('GATE BLOCCATO:',ex)
        code=2
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print('RAPPORTO:',dest)
    return code

if __name__=='__main__': sys.exit(main())
~~~~~

~~~~~python
def sha(p:Path)->str:
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()

def txt(p:Path)->str:
    return p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')

def jsonfile(p:Path):
    try: return json.loads(txt(p))
    except (OSError,UnicodeError,ValueError): return None

def latest(parent:Path,pat:str)->Path|None:
    files=list(parent.glob(pat)) if parent.exists() else []
    return max(files,key=lambda p:(p.stat().st_mtime,p.name)) if files else None

def fmt(p:Path|None)->str:
~~~~~

~~~~~powershell
    foreach($f in $staged) {
      if ($f -notmatch '^(src/|tools/|docs/|integrations/topflop-v53b/|pom\.xml$|README\.md$|INSTALL\.md$|CHANGELOG\.md$)') {
        throw "File inatteso nello staging: $f"
      }
      if ($f -match '(?i)(\.fca$|\.fcm$|recordsnext\.db|\.env|secret|token|credential|data/site-export|publish-sandbox)') {
        throw "File operativo riservato nello staging: $f"
      }
    }
    Write-Host ('FILE GIT IN STAGING: '+$staged.Count)
    & git -C $work diff --cached --stat
    Run-Checked 'Maven test su clone GitHub' { & mvn -f (Join-Path $work 'pom.xml') -B -q test }
    Run-Checked 'Commit GitHub' { & git -C $work commit -m 'RecordsNext4 v63 RC: 21-site sandbox audit, TopFlop frontend, updated code and docs' }
    # Esplicita autorizzazione utente a GitHub gia data. Nessun tag/release production.
    Run-Checked 'Push GitHub' { & git -C $work push -u origin $newBranch }
    Write-Host 'GITHUB PUSH OK:' $newBranch
    Write-Host 'WORKTREE GIT DEDICATO:' $work
    Write-Host 'CODICE E DOCUMENTAZIONE SINCRONIZZATI. RILASCIO REALE 3.2 ANCORA PENDENTE.'
}
~~~~~

~~~~~python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""RecordsNext 4 TEST v62: post-publication audit, READ ONLY.

The v59 generation gate correctly requires publishToSite=false BEFORE publishing,
but a GUI manual publication may leave it true afterwards. This audit accepts
true only after validating every configured destination against the sandbox;
it NEVER invokes an export, rewrites configuration, or touches the production E:.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import sqlite3
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r'D:\DEV_APPS\RecordsNext4.0_TEST_v37')
OUT = Path(r'D:\DEV_APPS\downloads')
WORK = ROOT / 'data/publish-sandbox-v52'
STATE = WORK / 'state.json'
SITES = WORK / 'sites'
LIMIT = 1_500_000


def require(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        raise RuntimeError(msg)


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def props(path):
    data = {}
    for ln in path.read_text(encoding='latin-1').splitlines():
        ln = ln.strip()
        if not ln or ln.startswith(('#','!')):
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^([^\s=:]+)\s*[=:]\s*(.*)$',ln)
        if m:
            data[m[1]] = re.sub(r'\\([:=\\])',lambda x:x[1],m[2])
    return data


def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    require(spec and spec.loader, 'Impossibile caricare verificatore: '+str(path))
    obj = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(obj)
    return obj


def inspect_isolation():
    require(ROOT.is_dir() and 'TEST' in ROOT.name.upper(), 'Root non TEST')
    require(STATE.is_file(), 'Sandbox non preparata: state.json mancante')
    state = json.loads(STATE.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    require(state.get('schema')=='rn4-publish-sandbox-v52', 'Manifest sandbox inatteso')
    require(state.get('root','').casefold()==str(ROOT).casefold(), 'Sandbox di altra installazione')
    selected = state.get('selected')
    require(isinstance(selected,list) and len(selected)==21 and len(selected)==len(set(selected)),
            'Attese esattamente le 21 stagioni selezionate nella sandbox')
    require(SITES.is_dir() and SITES.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()),
            'Root siti sandbox fuori dal TEST o collegato a directory esterna')
    require(STATE.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()), 'Manifest fuori TEST')
    require(set(state['original'])==set(state['sites']), 'Manifest incompleto')
    for season in selected:
        require(re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}_\d{4}',season), 'ID stagione non valido: '+str(season))
        require(state['original'].get(season), 'Stagione selezionata senza sito originale: '+season)
    config=ROOT/'config'
    gui=props(config/'recordsnext-gui.properties')
    chosen = [x.strip() for x in gui.get('seasons','').split(',') if x.strip()]
    require(len(chosen)==len(set(chosen)) and set(chosen)==set(selected),
            'Selezione stagioni GUI cambiata rispetto alla sandbox')
    require(gui.get('publish.destinationMode')=='custom', 'Destinazione GUI non custom')
    for key in ('siteJs','publish.customDirectory'):
        raw = gui.get(key)
        require(raw and Path(raw).resolve().is_relative_to(SITES.resolve()),
                'Percorso GUI fuori sandbox: '+key+' -> '+str(raw))
    with sqlite3.connect((ROOT/'data/database/recordsnext.db').resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro', uri=True) as db:
        rows=dict(db.execute('''SELECT s.season_id,c.local_site_path FROM rn_season s
                                LEFT JOIN rn_season_configuration c ON c.season_id=s.season_id'''))
    require(set(rows)==set(state['original']), 'Stagioni SQLite diverse dal manifest')
    manual=[]
    for season, target_string in rows.items():
        expected = (SITES/season).resolve()
        require(expected.is_relative_to(SITES.resolve()), 'Symlink/junction sito fuori sandbox: '+season)
        require(Path(state['sites'][season]).resolve()==expected,
                'Destinazione manifest differente: '+season)
        if target_string is None:
            require(season not in selected and state['original'][season] is None,
                    'Destinazione NULL per stagione attiva: '+season)
            manual.append(season)
            continue
        require(bool(target_string) and Path(target_string).resolve()==expected,
                'DESTINAZIONE FUORI SANDBOX: '+season+' -> '+str(target_string))
        require(expected.is_dir() and (expected/'js').is_dir(), 'Sito sandbox mancante: '+season)
        require((expected/'js').resolve().is_relative_to(SITES.resolve()),
                'Junction/symlink JS fuori sandbox: '+season)
    require('2005_2006' in manual and '2005_2006' not in selected,
            'Stagione manuale 2005/06 cambiata: interrompere')
    for name, digest in state.get('protectedHash',{}).items():
        require(name in ('player-identities.json','topflop.json'), 'Hash protetto non riconosciuto')
        require(sha(config/name).lower()==str(digest).lower(), 'File protetto alterato: '+name)
    require(set(state.get('protectedHash',{}))=={'player-identities.json','topflop.json'},
            'Hash configurazioni protette mancanti')
    flags=json.loads((config/'processing.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    pub=flags.get('processing',{}).get('output',{}).get('publishToSite')
    gui_pub=gui.get('processing.publish')
    require(type(pub) is bool and gui_pub in ('true','false'), 'Flag pubblicazione illeggibili')
    print('ISOLAMENTO CONFERMATO: 21 siti nel TEST, nessun target fuori sandbox')
    print('2005/06: manuale, nessun target; file protetti SHA-256 invariati')
    print('FLAG PUBBLICAZIONE: processing.json =',pub,'; GUI =',gui_pub)
    if pub or gui_pub=='true':
        print('ATTENZIONE: flag attivo. Audit consentito in SOLA LETTURA; disabilitarlo prima di qualsiasi altra elaborazione.')
    return state, {'processing_json':pub,'gui':gui_pub}


def audit():
    state, flags=inspect_isolation()
    base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    gate=module('rn4_v62_stage',base/'tools/GateStaging-v62.py')
    stage=gate.inspect()
    require(stage.get('status')=='STAGING_VERIFICATO_NON_RELEASE','Gate staging v59 non confermato')
    print('STAGING v58c:',stage['js_count'],'JS, max',stage['js_max_bytes'],'byte; FMT FCA',sum(i['official_rows'] for i in stage['fmt_seasons']))
    check=module('rn4_v62_multisito',base/'tools/Verifica-RN4-Multisito-v60.py')
    dist=check.verify()
    require(not dist['errors'], 'Auditor multisito v60 ha trovato '+str(len(dist['errors']))+' errori: '+repr(dist['errors'][:4]))
    require(dist['selected_seasons']==21,'Destinazioni pubblicate incomplete')
    require(dist['max_bytes']<=LIMIT,'JS oltre 1.500.000 byte')
    stage_js=Path(stage['js_dir'])
    source=gate.decode_facade(stage_js/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews.js')
    upstream={x['stagione']:{y['nome']:(y['byte'],str(y['sha256']).lower()) for y in x.get('files',[])}
              for x in source['stagioni']}
    require(len(upstream)==21,'Staging atteso di 21 stagioni')
    matched=0
    for site_info in dist['sites']:
        sid=site_info['season']
        real=SITES/sid/'js'
        meta=gate.decode_facade(real/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews.js')
        got={x['stagione']:x for x in meta.get('stagioni',[])}
        need={s for s in upstream if s<=sid}
        require(set(got)==need, 'Cutoff/catena storica non completa: '+sid+
                ' ricevute='+str(len(got))+' attese='+str(len(need)))
        for season, item in got.items():
            expected=upstream[season]
            actual={it['nome']:(it['byte'],str(it['sha256']).lower()) for it in item.get('files',[])}
            require(actual==expected,
                    'Manifest shard diverso dall ultimo staging certificato: '+sid+' / '+season)
            matched+=len(expected)
        print('SITO',sid,'JS',site_info['js_count'],'shard',site_info['tf_shards'],'cutoff',len(got),'OK')
    report={'status':'AUDIT_SANDBOX_OK_NON_RELEASE',
            'checked_at':dt.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
            'selected_sites':len(dist['sites']), 'total_js':dist['total_js'],
            'max_bytes':dist['max_bytes'],'shard_manifest_matches':matched,
            'official_fmt_rows':sum(i['official_rows'] for i in stage['fmt_seasons']),
            'fca_2012_votes':stage['fca_2012_votes'],
            'publish_flags':flags,'stage':stage['js_dir'],
            'manual_unconfigured':dist['manual_unconfigured_seasons'],
            'browser_verified':False,'production_modified':False}
    return report


def main():
    stamp=dt.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    out=OUT/('RN4_GATE_POSTPUB_v62_'+stamp+'.json')
    try:
        result=audit()
        print('AUDIT SANDBOX OK:',result['selected_sites'],'siti,',result['total_js'],
              'JS,',result['shard_manifest_matches'],'shard verificati contro staging')
        code=0
    except Exception as e:
        result={'status':'BLOCCATO','error':str(e)}
        print('AUDIT SANDBOX BLOCCATO:',e)
        code=2
    out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print('RAPPORTO:',out)
    return code


if __name__=='__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
~~~~~

~~~~~powershell
param([ValidateSet('plan','apply','verify')][string]$Mode='plan')

foreach($f in $manifest.files) {
~~~~~
