 function option(el,val,caption){const o=mk('option',caption);o.value=val;el.append(o);}
 function info(text){$('tf-feedback').textContent=text;}
 function loadScript(path){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const s=mk('script');s.src=path;s.async=true;s.onload=resolve;s.onerror=()=>reject(Error('Non riesco a caricare '+path));doc.head.append(s);});}
 function manifestSeason(season){return state.manifest.stagioni.find(x=>x.stagione===season);}
 function cacheData(season){let entry=state.loaded.get(season);if(!entry){entry={season,careers:null,teams:null,bench:null,real:null,counted:null,partial:{}};state.loaded.set(season,entry);}return entry;}
 function needed(id){return {teams:['TF06','TF16'].includes(id),bench:['TF11','TF12','TF13'].includes(id),real:['TF01','TF02'].includes(id),counted:['TF03','TF04'].includes(id),history:['TF14','TF15'].includes(id)};}
 async function ensureSection(season,kind){const data=cacheData(season),prop=kind==='RealPerformances'?'real':kind==='CountedPerformances'?'counted':kind.toLowerCase();
   if(data[prop]!==null)return;
   if(data.partial[prop])return data.partial[prop];
   const job=(async()=>{
     if(kind==='RealPerformances'||kind==='CountedPerformances'){
       const m=manifestSeason(season);if(!m)throw Error('Manifest v69 senza stagione '+season);
       const files=m.files.filter(f=>f.tipo===kind);for(const file of files)await loadScript('../js/'+file.nome);
       const arr=((root.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopViewsData||{})[kind]||{})[season]||[];
       if(arr.length!==files.reduce((n,f)=>n+f.righe,0))throw Error('Shard v69 incompleti: '+season+' '+kind);
       data[prop]=arr;
     } else data[prop]=await api.loadView('../js',season,kind);
   })();data.partial[prop]=job;
   try{await job;}finally{delete data.partial[prop];}
 }
 async function ensureHistory(){if(state.history!==null)return state.history;
   if(!state.historyPromise)state.historyPromise=api.loadHistory('../js').then(data=>{state.history=data;return data;}).catch(e=>{state.historyPromise=null;throw e;});
   return state.historyPromise;}
 async function ensureSeason(season,requirements){await ensureSection(season,'Careers');
   const jobs=[];
   if(requirements.teams)jobs.push(ensureSection(season,'Teams'));
   if(requirements.bench)jobs.push(ensureSection(season,'Bench'));
   if(requirements.real)jobs.push(ensureSection(season,'RealPerformances'));
   if(requirements.counted)jobs.push(ensureSection(season,'CountedPerformances'));
   await Promise.all(jobs);
 }
 async function calculate(token){
   const id=$('tf-record').value,scope=$('tf-season').value,
         seasons=scope==='__ALL__'?state.facade.stagioni.map(s=>s.stagione).sort():[scope], req=needed(id);
   let loaded=0;
   for(const season of seasons){
     if(token!==state.token)return;
     info('Caricamento '+(++loaded)+'/'+seasons.length+': '+seasonLabel(season)+' — '+engine.LABELS[id]);
     await ensureSeason(season,req);
   }
   if(req.history||(id==='TF09'&&$('tf-event-aggregate').value!=='SEASON'))await ensureHistory();
   if(token!==state.token)return;
   const opts={id,context:$('tf-context').value,event:$('tf-event').value,keeperEvent:$('tf-keeper-event').value,
     benchMetric:$('tf-bench-metric').value,metric:$('tf-team-metric').value,direction:$('tf-order').value,
     search:$('tf-search').value,thresholds:state.facade.soglie||{}};
   const index=seasons.map(season=>{
     const s=cacheData(season),meta=api.meta(season);
     return engine.indexedSeason({...s,dictionaries:meta.dizionari});
   });
   state.ranked=id==='TF09'?events.build(index,state.history||[],{
     group:$('tf-event-group').value,type:$('tf-event').value,
     aggregate:$('tf-event-aggregate').value,context:opts.context,
     direction:opts.direction,search:opts.search
   }):engine.build({seasons:index,history:state.history||[]},opts);
   render();info(id==='TF09'?'Eventi '+($('tf-event-group').value==='BONUS'?'positivi':'negativi')+
     ' · '+events.LABELS[$('tf-event').value]+' · '+($('tf-event-aggregate').selectedOptions[0].textContent)+
     ' · '+(opts.context==='real'?'FCA reale':'FCM conteggiato')+' · conteggi, non punti fantasy.':
     'Classifica '+engine.LABELS[id]+' — '+(scope==='__ALL__'?'assoluta':'stagione '+seasonLabel(scope))+'.');
 }
 function error(err,token){if(token!==state.token)return;info('ERRORE: '+err.message);$('tf-count').textContent='Dati insufficienti: '+err.message;clear($('tf-body'));}
 function refresh(){const token=++state.token;syncControls();calculate(token).catch(e=>error(e,token));}
 function syncControls(){const id=$('tf-record').value;
   const context=['TF07','TF08','TF09','TF10','TF17','TF18','TF20'].includes(id);
   $('tf-context-wrap').hidden=!context;
   $('tf-event-wrap').hidden=id!=='TF09';$('tf-event-group-wrap').hidden=id!=='TF09';
   $('tf-event-aggregate-wrap').hidden=id!=='TF09';$('tf-keeper-wrap').hidden=id!=='TF20';
   $('tf-team-wrap').hidden=id!=='TF16';$('tf-bench-wrap').hidden=id!=='TF13';
   const dir=$('tf-order');if(state.selected!==id){dir.value=['TF02','TF04','TF15'].includes(id)?'MIN':'MAX';state.selected=id;}
 }
 function td(row,text){row.append(mk('td',fmt(text)));}
 function playerButton(row){const cell=mk('td'),b=mk('button',row.name||row.playerKey);b.type='button';b.className='rn-tf-player';
   b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const q=new URLSearchParams({playerKey:row.playerKey,season:row.season,back:location.href});location.href='calciatori.html?'+q.toString();});cell.append(b);return cell;}
 function badge(target,label,value){const b=mk('div');b.className='rn-tf-stat';b.append(mk('small',label),mk('strong',fmt(value)));target.append(b);}
 function render(){const rows=state.ranked,size=$('tf-page-size').value;
   if($('tf-record').value==='TF09'){renderEventRanking(rows,size);return;}
   let count=size==='all'?rows.length:Math.min(rows.length,Number(size));
   $('tf-count').textContent=rows.length===0&&$('tf-record').value==='TF20'?
     'Nessun portiere con '+($('tf-keeper-event').selectedOptions[0].textContent.toLocaleLowerCase('it-IT'))+' nel periodo selezionato.':
     'Visualizzati '+count.toLocaleString('it-IT')+' / '+rows.length.toLocaleString('it-IT')+' risultati';
   clear($('tf-head'));clear($('tf-body'));const isKeeper=$('tf-record').value==='TF20';
   const tr=mk('tr');(isKeeper?['Pos.','Portiere','Stagione','Gol','di cui rigore','Assist','Gol + assist','Valore ordinato','Campione','Fonte']:
   ['Pos.','Calciatore','Stagione','Giornata','Fantasquadra','Competizione','Indicatore','Valore','Campione','Fonte']).forEach(x=>tr.append(mk('th',x)));$('tf-head').append(tr);
   clear($('tf-metrics'));
   badge($('tf-metrics'),'Risultati nella classifica',rows.length);badge($('tf-metrics'),'Periodo',$('tf-season').value==='__ALL__'?'Assoluta':seasonLabel($('tf-season').value));
   badge($('tf-metrics'),'Direzione',$('tf-order').value==='MAX'?'Dal maggiore':'Dal minore');badge($('tf-metrics'),'Dati',$('tf-context').value==='real'?'FCA reale':'FCM COUNTED');
   const ticket=++state.drawToken;
   if(state.renderObserver){state.renderObserver.disconnect();state.renderObserver=null;}
   const footer=$('tf-count').parentElement;
   const prior=doc.getElementById('tf-more-sentinel');if(prior)prior.remove();
   let shown=0;
   function batch(){if(ticket!==state.drawToken||shown>=count)return;
     const frag=doc.createDocumentFragment(),end=Math.min(count,shown+250);
     for(let i=shown;i<end;i++){
       const r=rows[i],tr=mk('tr');td(tr,r.position);tr.append(playerButton(r));td(tr,seasonLabel(r.season));
       if(isKeeper){td(tr,r.gol);td(tr,r.golSuRigore);td(tr,r.assist);td(tr,r.totaleOffensivo);td(tr,r.value);td(tr,r.sample);}
       else {td(tr,r.round||null);td(tr,r.team||null);td(tr,r.competition||null);td(tr,r.metric);td(tr,r.value);td(tr,r.sample);}
       const cell=mk('td');
       if(r.url&&/^(https?:\/\/|\.\.?\/)/i.test(r.url)){const a=mk('a','Tabellino');a.href=r.url;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';cell.append(a);}else cell.textContent=r.source||'—';
       tr.append(cell);frag.append(tr);
     }
     $('tf-body').append(frag);shown=end;
     $('tf-count').textContent=rows.length===0&&isKeeper?
       'Nessun portiere con '+$('tf-keeper-event').selectedOptions[0].textContent.toLocaleLowerCase('it-IT')+' nel periodo selezionato.':
       'Visualizzati '+shown.toLocaleString('it-IT')+' / '+rows.length.toLocaleString('it-IT')+' risultati';
     if(shown>=count && state.renderObserver){state.renderObserver.disconnect();state.renderObserver=null;}
   }
   if(size==='all'&&count>250&&root.IntersectionObserver){
     const sentinel=mk('span');sentinel.id='tf-more-sentinel';sentinel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
     sentinel.style.display='block';sentinel.style.height='1px';footer.append(sentinel);
     state.renderObserver=new root.IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
       if(ticket!==state.drawToken)return;
       if(entries.some(e=>e.isIntersecting)&&shown<count)batch();
     },{rootMargin:'500px'});
     batch();if(shown<count)state.renderObserver.observe(sentinel);
   }else{
     batch();
     if(shown<count){function next(){if(ticket!==state.drawToken)return;batch();if(shown<count)
       (root.requestAnimationFrame||root.setTimeout)(next,0);}
       (root.requestAnimationFrame||root.setTimeout)(next,0);
     }
   }
 }
 function renderEventRanking(rows,size){
   const group=$('tf-event-group').value,kind=$('tf-event').value,mode=$('tf-event-aggregate').value,
     src=$('tf-context').value,parts=events.GROUPS[group];
   const count=size==='all'?rows.length:Math.min(rows.length,Number(size));
   const ticket=++state.drawToken;
   if(state.renderObserver){state.renderObserver.disconnect();state.renderObserver=null;}
   const sentinel=doc.getElementById('tf-more-sentinel');if(sentinel)sentinel.remove();
   clear($('tf-head'));clear($('tf-body'));clear($('tf-metrics'));
   const label=events.LABELS[kind],sample=src==='real'?'Voti reali validi':'Apporti COUNTED';
   badge($('tf-metrics'),'Voci nella classifica',rows.length);
   badge($('tf-metrics'),'Tipo',label);
   badge($('tf-metrics'),'Aggregazione',$('tf-event-aggregate').selectedOptions[0].textContent);
   badge($('tf-metrics'),'Fonte',src==='real'?'FCA reale':'FCM conteggiato');
   const head=['Pos.','Calciatore','Periodo','Stagioni',sample,
     'Totale ('+label+')','Media annua','Picco annuo',
     src==='real'?'Per 100 voti':'Per 100 apporti','Composizione e annate'];
   const th=mk('tr');head.forEach(v=>th.append(mk('th',v)));$('tf-head').append(th);
   let shown=0;
   const fragmentSize=250;
   function batch(){if(ticket!==state.drawToken||shown>=count)return;
     const frag=doc.createDocumentFragment(),end=Math.min(count,shown+fragmentSize);
     for(let i=shown;i<end;i++){
       const r=rows[i],tr=mk('tr');td(tr,r.position);tr.append(playerButton(r));
       td(tr,r.seasonText);td(tr,r.years);td(tr,r.sample);
       const totalCell=mk('td',fmt(r.amount)),avgCell=mk('td',fmt(r.averagePerSeason)),
         rateCell=mk('td',fmt(r.per100));
       if(mode==='SEASON'||mode==='CAREER')totalCell.className='rn-tf-value-active';
       else if(mode==='AVERAGE')avgCell.className='rn-tf-value-active';
       else rateCell.className='rn-tf-value-active';
       tr.append(totalCell,avgCell);
       const peak=Math.max(...r.yearly.map(y=>kind==='TOTAL_'+group?
         parts.reduce((n,k)=>n+y.parts[k],0):y.parts[kind]));
       td(tr,peak);tr.append(rateCell);
       const cell=mk('td');const d=mk('details');d.className='rn-tf-drilldown';
       d.append(mk('summary',r.yearly.length>1?'Composizione e '+r.yearly.length+' anni':'Composizione'));
       const wrap=mk('div');wrap.className='rn-table-wrap';const table=mk('table');table.className='rn-table rn-tf-competition-table';
       const header=mk('tr');['Stagione',sample,events.LABELS[kind],...parts.map(k=>events.LABELS[k])].forEach(v=>header.append(mk('th',v)));
       const thead=mk('thead');thead.append(header);table.append(thead);const body=mk('tbody');
       r.yearly.forEach(y=>{const rr=mk('tr');
         [seasonLabel(y.season),y.sample,kind==='TOTAL_'+group?parts.reduce((n,k)=>n+y.parts[k],0):y.parts[kind],
           ...parts.map(k=>y.parts[k])].forEach(v=>td(rr,v));body.append(rr);});
       table.append(body);wrap.append(table);d.append(wrap);cell.append(d);
       tr.append(cell);frag.append(tr);
     }
     $('tf-body').append(frag);shown=end;
     $('tf-count').textContent='Visualizzati '+shown.toLocaleString('it-IT')+' / '+rows.length.toLocaleString('it-IT')+' risultati';
     if(shown>=count&&state.renderObserver){state.renderObserver.disconnect();state.renderObserver=null;}
   }
   if(size==='all'&&count>250&&root.IntersectionObserver){
     const foot=$('tf-count').parentElement,s=mk('span');s.id='tf-more-sentinel';s.style.display='block';s.style.height='1px';foot.append(s);
     state.renderObserver=new root.IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
       if(ticket===state.drawToken&&entries.some(e=>e.isIntersecting)&&shown<count)batch();
     },{rootMargin:'500px'});batch();if(shown<count)state.renderObserver.observe(s);
   }else{batch();if(shown<count){function next(){if(ticket!==state.drawToken)return;batch();
     if(shown<count)(root.requestAnimationFrame||root.setTimeout)(next,0);}
     (root.requestAnimationFrame||root.setTimeout)(next,0);}}
 }
 function updateEventTypes(){const family=$('tf-event-group').value,select=$('tf-event');
   const old=select.value;clear(select);
   events.TYPES[family].forEach(k=>option(select,k,events.LABELS[k]));
   select.value=events.TYPES[family].includes(old)?old:family==='MALUS'?'AMM':'TOTAL_BONUS';
 }
 function table(target,headers,rows){const wrap=mk('div'),t=mk('table');wrap.className='rn-table-wrap';t.className='rn-table';const thead=mk('thead'),th=mk('tr');headers.forEach(x=>th.append(mk('th',x)));thead.append(th);t.append(thead);
   const tbody=mk('tbody');rows.forEach(cols=>{const tr=mk('tr');cols.forEach(x=>td(tr,x));tbody.append(tr);});t.append(tbody);wrap.append(t);target.append(wrap);}
 function statBox(target,pairs){const el=mk('div');el.className='rn-tf-profile-badges';pairs.forEach(pair=>badge(el,pair[0],pair[1]));target.append(el);}
 async function ensureFMTManifest(){
   if(!state.fmtManifestPromise)state.fmtManifestPromise=loadScript('../js/fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopFcaFmt_v83.js')
     .then(()=>{const manifest=root.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtManifestV70;
       if(!manifest||manifest.schemaVersion!=='4.0-real-fmt-v70')throw Error('Manifest fantamedia FCA v70 non valido');
       return manifest;
     }).catch(e=>{state.fmtManifestPromise=null;throw e;});
   return state.fmtManifestPromise;
 }
 async function loadRealFMT(years){
   const manifest=await ensureFMTManifest(),available=new Map(manifest.stagioni.map(x=>[x.stagione,x]));
   const unique=[...new Set(years.map(x=>x.stagione))];
   await Promise.all(unique.map(async season=>{
     if(root.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70&&root.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70[season])return;
     const meta=available.get(season);if(!meta)throw Error('Fantamedia FCA non esportata per '+seasonLabel(season));
     if(!state.fmtPending.has(season))state.fmtPending.set(season,loadScript('../js/'+meta.nome)
       .catch(e=>{state.fmtPending.delete(season);throw e;}));
     await state.fmtPending.get(season);
     if(!root.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70||!root.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70[season])
       throw Error('Dati FCA fantamedia mancanti: '+season);
   }));
   return root.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70||{};
 }
 function profileTable(target,headers,rows){table(target,headers,rows);}
 function sortableTeamTable(target,original){
   const wrap=mk('div');wrap.className='rn-table-wrap';target.append(wrap);
   const sort={key:'stagione',dir:-1};
   const cols=[['stagione','Stagione'],['fantasquadra','Fantasquadra'],['gare','Gare'],
     ['mediaVoto','Media voto'],['fantamedia','Fantamedia'],['gol','Gol'],['assist','Assist'],
     ['golSuRigore','Gol rigore'],['rigoriSbagliati','Rigori sb.'],['ammonizioni','Amm.'],
     ['espulsioni','Esp.'],['autogol','Autogol'],['golSubiti','Gol subiti'],
     ['golSubitiSuRigore','Gol subiti rig.'],['rigParati','Rigori parati'],
     ['bonusPunti','Bonus punti'],['malusPunti','Malus punti'],['saldoPunti','Saldo'],['riconciliazione','Verifica'],
     ['deltaNetTabellino','Delta TOT−VOTO'],['numeroCompetizioni','Comp.']];
   function render(){clear(wrap);const tbl=mk('table');tbl.className='rn-table rn-tf-squad-summary';
     const thead=mk('thead'),thr=mk('tr');
     for(const [key,caption] of cols){const th=mk('th'),button=mk('button',caption+(sort.key===key?(sort.dir===1?' ▲':' ▼'):''));
       button.type='button';button.className='rn-tf-sort';
       button.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(sort.key===key)sort.dir*=-1;
         else {sort.key=key;sort.dir=['stagione','fantasquadra'].includes(key)?1:-1;}render();});
       th.setAttribute('aria-sort',sort.key===key?(sort.dir===1?'ascending':'descending'):'none');th.append(button);thr.append(th);}
     thr.append(mk('th','Dettaglio'));thead.append(thr);tbl.append(thead);const body=mk('tbody');
     const rows=original.slice().sort((a,b)=>{
       const x=a[sort.key],y=b[sort.key];if(x===null&&y===null)return 0;
       if(x===null)return 1;if(y===null)return -1;
       const dif=typeof x==='number'&&typeof y==='number'?x-y:String(x).localeCompare(String(y),'it');
       return sort.dir*dif||b.stagione.localeCompare(a.stagione)||a.fantasquadra.localeCompare(b.fantasquadra,'it');
     });
     for(const r of rows){const tr=mk('tr');for(const [key] of cols)
       td(tr,key==='stagione'?seasonLabel(r.stagione):r[key]);
       const cell=mk('td'),details=mk('details');details.className='rn-tf-drilldown';
       details.append(mk('summary',r.numeroCompetizioni+' competizion'+(r.numeroCompetizioni===1?'e':'i')));
       const nested=mk('div');nested.className='rn-table-wrap';const inner=mk('table');inner.className='rn-table rn-tf-competition-table';
       const row=mk('tr');const competitionCols=[['competizione','Competizione'],...cols.slice(2,-1)];
       competitionCols.forEach(([k,label])=>row.append(mk('th',label)));
       const head=mk('thead');head.append(row);inner.append(head);const tbody=mk('tbody');
       r.competizioni.forEach(c=>{const cr=mk('tr');competitionCols.forEach(([key])=>td(cr,c[key]));tbody.append(cr);});
       inner.append(tbody);nested.append(inner);details.append(nested);cell.append(details);tr.append(cell);body.append(tr);
     }tbl.append(body);wrap.append(tbl);
   }render();
 }
 function teamStat(t,metric,unit){if(!t)return '—';
   return t.fantasquadra+' · '+fmt(t[metric])+(unit||'');}
 async function loadScorecards(years){
   if(!state.pointsManifestPromise)state.pointsManifestPromise=loadScript('../js/fcmRecordsNext_ProfileManifest_v83.js')
     .then(()=>{const m=root.RecordsNextV79Manifest;if(!m||m.schemaVersion!=='4.0-profile-v79')
       throw Error('Manifest scorecard v79 errato');return m;});
   const manifest=await state.pointsManifestPromise,bySeason=new Map();
   for(const f of manifest.points){if(!bySeason.has(f.stagione))bySeason.set(f.stagione,[]);
     bySeason.get(f.stagione).push(f);}
   const wanted=[...new Set(years.map(x=>x.stagione))];
   await Promise.all(wanted.map(async season=>{
     const files=bySeason.get(season);if(!files||files.length===0)
       throw Error('Manca il tabellino v79 '+season);
     const count=files.reduce((n,f)=>n+f.righe,0);
     if(root.RecordsNextV79Points&&root.RecordsNextV79Points[season]?.righe?.length===count)return;
     if(!state.pointsPending.has(season))state.pointsPending.set(season,(async()=>{
       for(const f of files.sort((a,b)=>a.part-b.part))await loadScript('../js/'+f.nome);
       const actual=root.RecordsNextV79Points?.[season]?.righe||[];
       if(actual.length!==count)throw Error('Scorecard v79 incompleto '+season);
     })());
     try{await state.pointsPending.get(season);}catch(e){state.pointsPending.delete(season);throw e;}
   }));
   return wanted.flatMap(s=>((root.RecordsNextV79Points||{})[s]||{}).righe||[]);
 }
 async function enableGlobalSearch(){
   const query=$('tf-global-search'),target=$('tf-global-results');if(!query||!target)return;
   const global=root.RecordsNextGlobalSearchV79;if(!global)throw Error('Motore ricerca globale v79 assente');
   query.addEventListener('input',async()=>{
     const needle=query.value.trim();if(needle.length<2){clear(target);return;}
     target.textContent='Ricerca nell’archivio storico…';
     try{
       if(!state.globalPending)state.globalPending=global.loadAll(async name=>loadScript('../js/'+name),
         ()=>root.RecordsNextV79Manifest,()=>root.RecordsNextV79Index);
       const index=await state.globalPending;
       if(query.value.trim()!==needle)return;
       const found=global.search(index,needle,40);clear(target);
       target.append(mk('p',found.length+' risultati (identità approvate oppure stagionali separate).'));
       for(const item of found){const b=mk('button',item.name+' · '+item.start+'–'+item.end+
         (item.approved?' · identità approvata':' · identità stagionale'));
         b.type='button';b.className='rn-tf-global-option';b.addEventListener('click',()=>openProfile(item.playerKey,item.season));
         target.append(b);}
     }catch(e){target.textContent='Errore ricerca globale: '+e.message;state.globalPending=null;}
   });
 }
 async function openProfile(playerKey,season){const ticket=++state.profileToken,target=detail();
   target.hidden=false;clear(target);target.append(mk('p','Caricamento scheda giocatore…'));
   try{
     await ensureSection(season,'Careers');await ensureSection(season,'Teams');const ss=cacheData(season);
     const individual=ss.careers.find(p=>p.playerKey===playerKey);
     if(!individual)throw Error('Calciatore non trovato in '+seasonLabel(season));
     const history=await ensureHistory();
     const approved=history.find(h=>(h.stagioni||[]).some(s=>s.playerKey===playerKey&&s.stagione===season))||null;
     const years=approved?approved.stagioni:[{stagione:season,playerKey}];
     const [official,allContexts,scoreRows]=await Promise.all([
       loadRealFMT(years),
       Promise.all(years.map(async y=>{
         await ensureSection(y.stagione,'Teams');
         return profile.seasonTeamContexts(cacheData(y.stagione).teams,y.stagione,y.playerKey);
       })).then(items=>items.flat()),
       loadScorecards(years)
     ]);
     if(approved){
       const expected=approved.fantasquadrePerStagione||[];
       // The History facade must enumerate precisely the contexts that are now
       // being enriched from actual per-season FCM Teams shards.

/* RecordsNext 4.0 - public Top & Flop VIEWS decoder v2 (v48).
 * Only selected records and aggregated careers/teams; no complete FCM/FCA dump.
 * Lazy loading: do NOT preload all years or sections. Caller applies historical cutoff.
 */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  var pending = Object.create(null);
  function facade() {
    var f = root.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopViews;
    if (!f || f.schemaVersion !== '4.0-public-views-v1') {
      throw new Error('RecordsNext TopFlop: incompatible views facade');
    }
    return f;
  }
  function meta(season) {
    var found = facade().stagioni.find(function (s) { return s.stagione === season; });
    if (!found) throw new Error('Unknown season (or past cutoff): ' + season);
    return found;
  }
  function pairs(vector) {
    var keys = facade().eventi, out = {};
    if (!Array.isArray(vector) || vector.length % 2 !== 0) throw new Error('Invalid event vector');
    for (var i = 0; i < vector.length; i += 2) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(vector[i]) || !keys[vector[i]] || Object.hasOwn(out,keys[vector[i]]))
        throw new Error('Invalid event index');
      out[keys[vector[i]]] = vector[i + 1];
    }
    return out;
  }
  function average(sum,n) { return n > 0 ? sum / n : null; }
  function cost(row) {
    if (!row) return null;
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== 4) throw new Error('Invalid cost vector');
    return {registrazioniConCosto:row[0],minimo:row[1] === ''?null:row[1],
      massimo:row[2] === ''?null:row[2],medio:row[3] === ''?null:row[3],
      origine:'FCM.Tesserato.COSTOACQ'};
  }
  function unused(row) {
    if (!row) return null;
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== 5) throw new Error('Invalid unused vector');

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rebuilds complete, versioned RN4 Bible v48 from original canonical v47
and ALL current v83 integration code/docs. No destructive overwrites.
Does not run untrusted scripts and does not remove any previous Bible/report.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, sys

def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def emit(project,baseline,output):
    if not baseline.is_file():raise FileNotFoundError('Bibbia v47 canonica assente: '+str(baseline))
    if output.exists():raise FileExistsError('Versione v48 esistente: preservare, non sovrascrivere: '+str(output))
    snippets=[
        'src/main/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/app/topflop/TopFlopIntegratedV83.java',
        'src/main/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/app/topflop/TopFlopViewsPublication.java',
        'src/main/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/app/RecordsNextPipeline.java',
        'src/main/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/gui/RecordsNext2Dashboard.java',
        'src/test/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/app/topflop/TopFlopIntegratedV83Test.java',
        'src/test/java/it/alterlega/recordsnext/app/RecordsNextPipelineV83PublishTest.java',
        'tests/regression_v83.js',
        *('assets/js/'+s for s in (
          'fcmRecordsNextTopFlopRankingEngine_v83.js','fcmRecordsNextEventRanking_v83.js',
          'fcmRecordsNextFunzioni_topflop_v83.js','fcmRecordsNextCalciatori_v83.js',
          'fcmRecordsNextTopFlopViewsDecoder-v2.js', 'fcmRecordsNextPlayerProfile_v79.js',
          'fcmRecordsNextGlobalSearch_v79.js')),
        *('assets/RecordsNext/'+s for s in ('top_flop.html','calciatori.html','top_flop_v83.css')),
        'tools/Genera-Bibbia-RecordsNext-v83.py',
        'tools/Verifica-RN4-Integrazione-v83.py',
        'tools/Oracolo-FCM-v79-readonly.py',
        *('docs/'+s for s in (
          'RECORDSNEXT4_INTEGRAZIONE_NATIVA_v83.md',
          'DIARIO_IMPLEMENTAZIONE_RECORDSNEXT4_v83.md',
          'REGISTRO_DECISIONI_RECORDSNEXT4_v43.md',
          'CHANGELOG_RECORDSNEXT4_v83.md',
          'CATALOGO_VERIFICHE_RECORDSNEXT4_v83.md',
          'TEST_E_GIT_RECORDSNEXT4_v83.md')),
    ]
    missing=[s for s in snippets if not (project/s).is_file()]
    if missing:raise FileNotFoundError('File di integrazione assenti: '+', '.join(missing))
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with output.open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as w:
        w.write('# CODICE FUNZIONANTE RECORDSNEXT4 — Bibbia canonica v48 (integrazione v83)\n\n')
        w.write('Stato: **candidato compilato e testato su fixture, NON CERTIFICATO sui 21 RAW FCM/classici/serie/RU/Culometro**.\n\n')
        w.write('La sezione A conserva byte-per-contenuto l’intera Bibbia v47 della RC v81.\n')
        w.write('La sezione B contiene i FILE V83 COMPLETI che prevalgono sulle copie precedenti della v47.\n')
        w.write('La verifica del DB Windows e Git restano gate separati.\n\n')
        w.write('## A — Bibbia canonica storica v47, integra\n\n')
        w.write('Origine SHA256 `'+sha(baseline)+'`. I passaggi di codice sostituiti dalla sezione B non sono piu autoritativi.\n\n')
        w.write(baseline.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        w.write('\n\n## B — Codice nativo v83 e documentazione completa, autorevoli\n\n')
        for relative in snippets:
            file=project/relative
            ext=file.suffix.lower()
            lang={'.java':'java','.js':'javascript','.py':'python','.html':'html','.css':'css','.md':'markdown'}.get(ext,'text')
            content=file.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
            fence='`'*(max((len(x) for x in __import__('re').findall(r'`+',content)),default=2)+2)
            w.write('\n### `'+relative+'`\n\nSHA256 `'+sha(file)+'`; bytes '+str(file.stat().st_size)+'\n\n')
            w.write(fence+lang+'\n'+content.rstrip()+'\n'+fence+'\n')
    return {'path':str(output),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(output),'sources':len(snippets)}

if __name__=='__main__':
    a=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    a.add_argument('--root',type=Path,required=True)
    a.add_argument('--baseline',type=Path,default=None)
    a.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=None)
    args=a.parse_args()
    p=args.root.resolve();baseline=(args.baseline or p/'docs/CODICE_FUNZIONANTE_RECORDSNEXT4_v47.md').resolve()
    output=(args.output or p/'docs/CODICE_FUNZIONANTE_RECORDSNEXT4_v48.md').resolve()
    try:print('RN4_V83_BIBBIA_GENERATA',json.dumps(emit(p,baseline,output),ensure_ascii=False))
    except Exception as ex:print('RN4_V83_BIBBIA_BLOCCATA',ex,file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(2)
```

}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Integrated v83 verification: existing FCA v81 oracles versus native site JS,
plus INDEPENDENT raw FCM 21-season oracle (original v79 reader) versus Java points.
Reads SQLite in mode=ro; writes only the user-requested downloads report files.
No publish, no commits. Distinguishes partial coverage from verified results.
"""
import argparse, collections, csv, hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, sqlite3, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

EVENTS=('GOLFATTI1','GOLFATTISURIGORE1','ASSIST','RIGSBA','AMM','ESP','AUTOGOL1','GOLSUBITI','GOLSUBITISURIGORE','RIGPAR')
PREFIXES={'facade':'window.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopViews = ',
          'full':'window.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopFullV69 = ',
          'profile':'window.RecordsNextV79Manifest = '}

def assigned(file,prefix):
    s=file.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip()
    if not s.startswith(prefix) or not s.endswith(';'):
        raise RuntimeError('Invalid JS manifest: '+str(file))
    return json.loads(s[len(prefix):-1])

def rows(file):
    raw=file.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    # Native view: a.push(...[ ... ]); or native points: .push(...[ ... ]);
    p=raw.find('.push(...[')

    p+=len('.push(...[')
    end=raw.rfind(']);')
    if end<p:raise RuntimeError('Unterminated shard '+str(file))
    return json.loads('['+raw[p:end]+']')

def near(a,b):
    if a is None or b is None:return a is None and b is None
    try:return abs(float(a)-float(b))<0.011
    except (ValueError,TypeError):return a==b

def check_site(db,site,oracle,output):
    js=site/'js';errors=[];warnings=[];counts=collections.Counter();examples=[]
    def err(text):
        errors.append(text) if len(errors)<100 else None
        counts['errors_total']+=1
    def warn(text):
        warnings.append(text) if len(warnings)<100 else None
        counts['warnings_total']+=1
    facade=assigned(js/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews.js',PREFIXES['facade'])
    full=assigned(js/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopFull_v83.js',PREFIXES['full'])
    manifest=assigned(js/'fcmRecordsNext_ProfileManifest_v83.js',PREFIXES['profile'])
    seasons=[s['stagione'] for s in facade['stagioni']]
    if len(seasons)!=len(set(seasons)) or not seasons:err('Cutoff invalido o duplicato')
    if set(seasons)!=set(s['stagione'] for s in full['stagioni']) or set(seasons)!=set(manifest['seasons']):
        err('Manifest Full/Profile incoerenti con cutoff facade')
    meta={s['stagione']:s for s in facade['stagioni']}
    fullmeta={s['stagione']:s for s in full['stagioni']}
    event_names=facade['eventi'];by_season={};reals={};teams={}
    for season in seasons:
        career=[];t=[];real=[]
        for rec in meta[season]['files']:
            typ=rec['tipo'];name=rec['nome']
            if typ not in ('Careers','Teams'):continue
            block=rows(js/name)
            if len(block)!=rec['righe']:err('Shard incompleto '+name)
            (career if typ=='Careers' else t).extend(block)
        for rec in fullmeta[season]['files']:
            if rec['tipo']!='RealPerformances':continue
            block=rows(js/rec['nome']);real.extend(block)
            if len(block)!=rec['righe']:err('Full shard incompleto '+rec['nome'])
        by_season[season]={r[0]:r for r in career};teams[season]=t;reals[season]=real
        if len(by_season[season])!=len(career):err('Doppia identita FCA '+season)
        counts['player_seasons']+=len(career)
        counts['real_performances']+=len(real)
    # Independently recorded v81 FCA player-season counts & events.
    with (oracle/'ORACOLO_EVENTI_FCA_v81.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as fh:
        for c in csv.DictReader(fh,delimiter=';'):
            season=c['Stagione'];key=c['PlayerKey'];counts['fca_oracle_rows']+=1
            if season not in by_season:continue
            item=by_season[season].get(key)
            if item is None:err('FCA identita mancante '+key);continue
            valid=item[4][0]
            if int(c['VotiValidi'])!=valid:err('FCA voti diversi '+key)
            vals=dict((event_names[i],int(v)) for i,v in zip(item[4][2][::2],item[4][2][1::2]))
            for field in EVENTS:
                if int(c[field])!=vals.get(field,0):err('FCA eventi diversi '+key+' '+field)
            counts['fca_compared']+=1
    for season in seasons:
        if season not in reals:continue
        perf=reals[season]
        keys=[(int(r[0]),int(r[1])) for r in perf]
        if len(keys)!=len(set(keys)):err('FCA performance duplicate '+season)
        for row in perf:
            if row[2]!='' and float(row[2])<=0:err('Voto FCA non positivo in Full '+season)
    with (oracle/'ORACOLO_VOTI_TF01_TF02_v81.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as fh:
        for c in csv.DictReader(fh,delimiter=';'):
            season=c['Stagione']
            if season not in reals:continue
            target=(int(c['IDPlayer']),int(c['Giornata']))
            found=[r for r in reals[season] if (int(r[0]),int(r[1]))==target]
            if len(found)!=1 or not near(found[0][2],c['Voto']):
                err('TF01/02 ancora vote non corrispondente '+season+' '+str(target))
            counts['vote_anchors']+=1
    with (oracle/'PRIMATI_PORTIERI_TF20_v81.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as fh:
        for c in csv.DictReader(fh,delimiter=';'):
            season=c['Stagione'];key=c['PlayerKey']
            if season not in by_season:continue
            r=by_season[season].get(key)
            if r is None:err('TF20 portiere assente '+key);continue
            if int(r[2])!=1:err('TF20 ruolo non portiere '+key)
            e={event_names[i]:v for i,v in zip(r[4][2][::2],r[4][2][1::2])}
            for col,field in [('Gol','GOLFATTI1'),('GolSuRigore','GOLFATTISURIGORE1'),('Assist','ASSIST'),
                ('RigoriParati','RIGPAR'),('GolSubiti','GOLSUBITI')]:
                if int(c[col])!=e.get(field,0):err('TF20 '+key+' '+col)
            if int(c['Voti'])!=r[4][0]:err('TF20 voti diversi '+key)
            counts['tf20_rows']+=1
    # Independent FCM raw reader from the v79 implementation; this has never
    # been used to generate the v83 Java output.
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('rn4_v79_oracle',Path(__file__).with_name('Oracolo-FCM-v79-readonly.py'))
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    conn=sqlite3.connect('file:'+db.resolve().as_posix()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
    conn.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
    for season in seasons:
        expected,audit=module.load_one_season(conn,season)
        native=[]
        for entry in manifest['points']:
            if entry['stagione']!=season:continue
            block=rows(js/entry['nome']);native.extend(block)
            if len(block)!=entry['righe']:err('Punti shard incompleto '+entry['nome'])
        keys=lambda x:(x['playerKey'],int(x['idSquadraInterno']),int(x['idCompetizioneInterno']))
        expectedMap={keys(x):x for x in expected};nativeMap={keys(x):x for x in native}
        if len(nativeMap)!=len(native) or set(nativeMap)!=set(expectedMap):
            err('FCM contesti/membership diversi '+season+' native='+str(len(native))+' independent='+str(len(expected)))
        for key,exp in expectedMap.items():
            actual=nativeMap.get(key)
            if not actual:continue
            for field in ('gare','totSum','pairs','votoFcmSum','saldoPunti','deltaNetTabellino',
                          'bonusPunti','malusPunti','certified'):
                if not near(actual[field],exp[field]):err('FCM differenza '+season+' '+str(key)+' '+field)
            for field in EVENTS:
                if not near(actual['events'][field],exp['events'][field]):err('FCM evento '+season+' '+str(key)+' '+field)
            counts['fcm_context_compared']+=1
        # Compare native Teams counted denominator and TOT against v79 independently.
        actualTeams=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0.0])
        for row in teams[season]:
            # Packed Team: [playerKey,teamId,competitionId, fantasy, cost]
            key=(row[0],int(row[1]),int(row[2]));actualTeams[key][0]+=int(row[3][1]);
            actualTeams[key][1]+=float(row[3][4]);
        for key,exp in expectedMap.items():
            if int(exp['gare'])==0:continue
            t=actualTeams.get(key)
            if not t or t[0]!=exp['gare'] or not near(t[1],exp['totSum']):err('FCM Team score mismatch '+season+' '+str(key))
        counts['fcm_counted']+=audit['counts'].get('counted',0)
    conn.close()
    for f in js.glob('*.js'):
        if f.name.startswith('fcmRecordsNext') and f.stat().st_size>1_500_000:
            err('JS RecordsNext oltre limite: '+f.name+' '+str(f.stat().st_size))
    if '2026_2027' in by_season:
        positive=[]
        for k,item in by_season['2026_2027'].items():
            if int(item[2])!=1 or item[4][0]<=0:continue
            e={event_names[i]:int(v) for i,v in zip(item[4][2][::2],item[4][2][1::2])}
            if e.get('GOLFATTI1',0)>0:err('TF20 2026/27 non zero gol '+k)
            if e.get('ASSIST',0)>0:positive.append((k,e['ASSIST']))
        if positive!=[('2026_2027:136',1)]:err('TF20 2026/27 assist non riconciliati '+str(positive))
    result={'schemaVersion':'rn4-integration-gate-v83','status':'PARITY_VERIFIED_FOR_CHECKED_SOURCES' if not counts['errors_total'] else 'BLOCKED',
            'counts':dict(counts),'errors':errors,'warnings':warnings,
            'limits':'This does NOT verify classic/series/RU/modifiers/thresholds/Culometro against RAW independent oracles',
            'db':str(db),'site':str(site),'previous_v81_reused':True}
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (output/'RN4_VERIFICA_INTEGRAZIONE_v83.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    summary=['# RN4 v83 - verifica indipendente','',f"Stato: **{result['status']}**",'']
    summary.extend(f'- {k}: {v}' for k,v in sorted(counts.items()))
    summary.extend(['','## Errori (primi 100)',*(('- '+x) for x in errors),'','## Limiti',result['limits'],''])
    (output/'RN4_VERIFICA_INTEGRAZIONE_v83.md').write_text('\n'.join(summary),encoding='utf-8')
    print('RN4_V83_VERIFY',json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'counts':dict(counts)}))
    return 0 if not counts['errors_total'] else 3

if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--db',type=Path,required=True);ap.add_argument('--site',type=Path,required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--oracle',type=Path,required=True);ap.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
    args=ap.parse_args()
    try:sys.exit(check_site(args.db,args.site,args.oracle,args.out))
    except Exception as e:
        print('V83_VERIFICA_ERRORE',str(e),file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3

folder. MODIF is the observed fantasy balance, verified against TOT - VOTO.

import argparse
import collections
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sqlite3

LIM = 1_500_000

N = re.compile(r'^[+-]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?$')
EVENTS = ('GOLFATTI1','ASSIST','GOLFATTISURIGORE1','RIGSBA','AMM','ESP',
          'AUTOGOL1','GOLSUBITI','GOLSUBITISURIGORE','RIGPAR')


def die(msg): raise RuntimeError(msg)

def numeric(raw):
    if raw is None or not N.fullmatch(str(raw).strip()): return None

def quote(n):
    check(bool(re.fullmatch('[a-zA-Z0-9_]+',n)), 'SQL identifier invalid: '+n)
    return '"'+n+'"'
def cols(c,table):
    return {r[1].upper():r[1] for r in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info('+quote(table)+')')}
def jsonp(var, payload):
    return ('window.'+var+'=window.'+var+'||{};\n' if var.endswith('Data') else '') + 'window.'+var+' = '+json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))+';\n'
def write_js(path, contents):
    raw=contents.encode('utf-8');check(0<len(raw)<=LIM,f'JS oversize {path}: {len(raw)} bytes')
    check(not path.exists(), 'Output exists, choose empty staging: '+str(path))
    path.write_bytes(raw)
    return {'nome':path.name,'byte':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}


def shards(out,season,rows,kind):
    """Bounded append-only JS shards; one file never exceeds 1,500,000 bytes."""
    check(kind in ('Points','Index'),'Invalid shard kind')
    var='RecordsNextV79Points' if kind=='Points' else 'RecordsNextV79Index'
    prefix=('window.'+var+'=window.'+var+'||{};\n')
    initialization=(('window.'+var+'['+json.dumps(season)+']=window.'+var+'['+json.dumps(season)+']||'+
       ('{"schemaVersion":"4.0-scorecard-points-v79","stagione":'+json.dumps(season)+',"righe":[]}'
         if kind=='Points' else '[]')+';\n'))
    expression='window.'+var+'['+json.dumps(season)+']'+('.righe' if kind=='Points' else '')
    def content(items):
        return prefix+initialization+expression+'.push(...'+json.dumps(items,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))+');\n'
    bundles=[];current=[];current_bytes=0
    for row in rows:
        encoded=len(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8'))
        if current and current_bytes+encoded+200>850_000:
            bundles.append(current);current=[];current_bytes=0
        check(encoded+200<=LIM, 'Oversize unshardable single row')
        current.append(row);current_bytes+=encoded+1
    if current or not bundles:bundles.append(current)
    meta=[]
    for n,chunk in enumerate(bundles,1):
        name='fcmRecordsNext_'+('ProfilePoints' if kind=='Points' else 'PlayerIndex')+'_v79_'+season+'_'+str(n).zfill(3)+'.js'
        info=write_js(out/name,content(chunk))
        meta.append({'stagione':season,'part':n,'righe':len(chunk),**info})
    check(sum(x['righe'] for x in meta)==len(rows),'Shard row coverage mismatch')
    return meta

# Rules explicitly confirmed by the league administrator. Variants for penalty
# goals and missed penalties must be resolved by the original FCM MODIF value.
FIXED = {'ASSIST':Decimal('1'), 'RIGPAR':Decimal('3'), 'AMM':Decimal('0.5'),
         'ESP':Decimal('1'), 'AUTOGOL1':Decimal('2'), 'GOLSUBITI':Decimal('1')}


def reconstruct(event, observed, absent=()):
    """Return (bonus, malus, status, candidates) in real fantasy POINTS.

    No mixing of FCA event *counts* with FCM score without a per-appearance
    reconciliation. Under-determined splits remain null rather than invented.
    """
    if absent:
        return None,None,'MISSING_FIELDS',[]
    if event['GOLFATTISURIGORE1'] > event['GOLFATTI1']:
        return None,None,'INVALID_PENALTY_SUBSET',[]
    if event['GOLSUBITISURIGORE'] > event['GOLSUBITI']:
        return None,None,'INVALID_CONCEDED_SUBSET',[]
    normal_goals=event['GOLFATTI1']-event['GOLFATTISURIGORE1']
    basic_bonus=normal_goals*3+event['ASSIST']*FIXED['ASSIST']+event['RIGPAR']*FIXED['RIGPAR']
    basic_malus=(event['AMM']*FIXED['AMM']+event['ESP']*FIXED['ESP']+
        event['AUTOGOL1']*FIXED['AUTOGOL1']+event['GOLSUBITI']*FIXED['GOLSUBITI'])
    goals_coeff=(Decimal(2),Decimal(3)) if event['GOLFATTISURIGORE1'] else (Decimal(3),)
    missed_coeff=(Decimal(2),Decimal(3)) if event['RIGSBA'] else (Decimal(3),)
    candidates=set()
    for pg in goals_coeff:
        for ps in missed_coeff:
            bonus=basic_bonus+event['GOLFATTISURIGORE1']*pg
            malus=basic_malus+event['RIGSBA']*ps

        bonus,malus=next(iter(candidates))
        return bonus,malus,'RECONCILED',[(num(bonus),num(malus))]
    if len(candidates)>1:
        return None,None,'AMBIGUOUS_SPLIT',[(num(a),num(b)) for a,b in sorted(candidates)]

def parse_record(tokens,pid):

    sql=f'''SELECT f.IDGIOC AS pid, f.IDSQUADRA AS team, f.IDINCONTRO AS mid,
       i.GIORNATADIA AS day, i.GIOCATO AS played,
       cp.ID AS cid, cp.NOME AS cname,
       t.LISTA AS slots, t.VOTO AS votes, t.MODIF AS modifiers, t.TOT AS totals,
       {fields}
    FROM {quote(fcm+'formazione')} f
    JOIN {quote(fcm+'incontro')} i ON i.ID=f.IDINCONTRO
    JOIN {quote(fcm+'girone')} g ON g.ID=i.IDGIRONE
    JOIN {quote(fcm+'competizione')} cp ON cp.ID=g.IDCOMPETIZIONE
    JOIN {quote(fcm+'tabellino')} t ON t.IDINCONTRO=f.IDINCONTRO AND t.IDSQUADRA=f.IDSQUADRA
    JOIN {quote(fca+'giocain')} d ON d.IDGIOCATORE=f.IDGIOC AND d.GIORNATA=i.GIORNATADIA
    JOIN {quote(fca+'punteggio')} p ON p.ID=d.IDPUNTEGGIO

    c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    by={};seen=set();audit=collections.Counter();examples=[]
    for row in c.execute(sql):
        audit['formation_rows']+=1

        if int(row['played'] or 0)!=1:continue

        check(slot is not None, f'FCM formation missing in tabellino: {season}/{row["mid"]}/{pid}')
        arrays=[str(row[k] or '').split('%') for k in ('slots','votes','modifiers','totals')]

          'gare':x['gare'],'totSum':num(x['totSum']),

          'unresolvedReasons':dict(x['unresolved']),'pointsMethod':'FCM_MODIF_RECONSTRUCTED_v79',
          'events':{k:(int(x['events'][k]) if k not in x['missing'] else None) for k in EVENTS},

    audit['certified_contexts']=sum(x['certified'] for x in result)
    audit['observed_saldo_contexts']=sum(x['saldoPunti'] is not None for x in result)
    return result, {'season':season,'counts':dict(audit),'missingFcaFields':absent,'exceptions':examples,
      'certification':'saldo = MODIF FCM osservato; bonus/malus solo se lo split e univoco e TUTTI gli incontri del contesto riconciliati'}

def build_index(c,seasons,approved):
    data={};counts={}
    for season in seasons:
        table='raw_'+season+'_fca_giocatorea';fields=cols(c,table)
        check({'ID','NOME'}.issubset(fields), 'Missing player ID or NAME '+season)
        code='CODICEGAZZA' if 'CODICEGAZZA' in fields else None
        birth='DATADINASCITA' if 'DATADINASCITA' in fields else None
        role='RUOLO' if 'RUOLO' in fields else None
        stmt='SELECT '+','.join(quote(fields[x]) if x else 'NULL' for x in ['ID','NOME',code,birth,role])+' FROM '+quote(table)
        rows=[];keys=set()
        for pid,name,gazza,date,ruolo in c.execute(stmt):
            key=f'{season}:{int(pid)}';check(key not in keys,'Duplicate FCA identity '+key);keys.add(key)
            canon=approved.get(key) or key
            rows.append([key,canon,str(name or '').strip(),str(date or '')[:10],
                         str(gazza) if gazza is not None else '',str(ruolo) if ruolo is not None else ''])
        counts[season]=len(rows);data[season]=rows
    return data,counts

def export(db, registry, site, output):
    check(output.is_dir() and not any(output.iterdir()), 'Use empty staging folder: '+str(output))
    c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+db.resolve().as_posix()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
    c.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
    facade=site/'js'/'fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopViews.js'
    raw=facade.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip()
    prefix='window.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopViews = '
    check(raw.startswith(prefix) and raw.endswith(';'),'Public facade format mismatch')
    manifest=json.loads(raw[len(prefix):-1]);check(manifest.get('schemaVersion')=='4.0-public-views-v1','Unknown public facade')
    seasons=[x['stagione'] for x in manifest['stagioni']]
    check(0<len(seasons)<=30 and len(seasons)==len(set(seasons)),'Invalid published seasons list')
    for season in seasons:check(SEASON.fullmatch(season),'Invalid published season '+season)
    cfg=json.loads(registry.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    check(cfg.get('schemaVersion')=='rn4-player-identities-v1' and isinstance(cfg.get('approved'),dict),
          'Player registry schema mismatch')
    report={'schemaVersion':'rn4-v79-audit','database':str(db),'site':str(site),
            'seasons':seasons,'seasonAudit':[],'scoringMethod':'v79-modif-observed-unique-split'}
    points_meta=[];search_meta=[]
    data_index,counts=build_index(c,seasons,cfg['approved'])
    for season in seasons:
        rows,audit=load_one_season(c,season)
        report['seasonAudit'].append(audit)
        points_meta.extend(shards(output,season,rows,'Points'))
        search_meta.extend(shards(output,season,data_index[season],'Index'))
    write_js(output/'fcmRecordsNext_ProfileManifest_v79.js','window.RecordsNextV79Manifest='+json.dumps({
      'schemaVersion':'4.0-profile-v79','seasons':seasons,'points':points_meta,'index':search_meta,
      'rulesStatus':'MODIF is observed from FCM; bonus/malus reconciled only when unique'
    },ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))+';\n')
    c.close()
    report['totals']={'seasons':len(seasons),'counted':sum(a['counts'].get('counted',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'certifiedContexts':sum(a['counts'].get('certified_contexts',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'reconciledContexts':sum(a['counts'].get('certified_contexts',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'observedSaldoContexts':sum(a['counts'].get('observed_saldo_contexts',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'unexplainedScorecards':sum(a['counts'].get('UNEXPLAINED_MODIF',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'ambiguousScorecards':sum(a['counts'].get('AMBIGUOUS_SPLIT',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'contexts':sum(a['counts'].get('contexts',0) for a in report['seasonAudit']),
      'searchRows':sum(counts.values())}
    (output/'AUDIT_SCHEDA_v79.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    return report

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--db',type=Path,required=True);ap.add_argument('--registry',type=Path,required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--site',type=Path,required=True);ap.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
    a=ap.parse_args();a.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    rep=export(a.db,a.registry,a.site,a.out)
    print('RN4_V79_EXPORT_OK',json.dumps(rep['totals'],ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as exc:
        import sys,traceback
        print('STOP V79 EXPORT: '+str(exc),file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
````

# RecordsNext 4.0 — integrazione nativa v83

Data: 17 novembre 2026. Baseline: RC v64 / checkpoint v67 `3e8d53f` dichiarato (da confermare sul PC).
Origine: dossier v82, maestro v81, audit v81, sorgenti RC reali v81 (243 sorgenti).

## Ambito definitivo di questa revisione

Unico flusso GUI `Genera / Verifica / Pubblica`. Nessuna seconda esportazione autonoma.
Il motore Java aggiunge allo staging esistente: RealPerformances FCA, CountedPerformances FCM, fantamedia FCA ufficiale accettata solo con presenze verificabili, saldo tabellino e bonus/malus FCM, indice globale di identita approvate; la pipeline pubblica insieme JS e `RecordsNext/top_flop.html`, `RecordsNext/calciatori.html` e CSS.
Il frontend Top & Flop mostra esclusivamente classifiche e filtro; l'Archivio calciatori cerca tutto lo storico del sito (es. Klose), apre schede stagionali o carriere approvate e permette collegamenti diretti dalla classifica.

### Contratti dati

- Tutti i risultati FCM si riferiscono SOLO a `COUNTED`; stessa prestazione FCA reale non viene moltiplicata dalle coppe.
- `MODIF=TOT-VOTO`. Saldo annuale per fantasquadra = somma dei MODIF dei COUNTED. Mai aggiungere MODIF due volte.
- Gol +3, assist +1, rigore parato +3, ammonizione -0,5, espulsione -1, autogol -2, gol subito -1; gol su rigore +2/+3, rigore sbagliato -2/-3 solo se ricostruzione univoca col saldo osservato.
- Bonus e malus **punti** = valori separati SOLO quando ogni COUNTED del contesto e riconciliabile e lo split e univoco. Altrimenti entrambi `null` e motivazione; saldo resta disponibile se verificato.
- `GOLFATTISURIGORE1` sottoinsieme di `GOLFATTI1`; `GOLSUBITISURIGORE` sottoinsieme di `GOLSUBITI`. Una statistica zero non e un valore mancante.
- Scheda 15 indicatori per stagione x fantasquadra e per competizione: fantamedia, media voto, gol, assist, gol su rigore, rigori sbagliati, ammonizioni, espulsioni, autogol, gol subiti, gol subiti su rigore, rigori parati, bonus punti, malus punti, saldo; con numero gare utilizzate e badge saldo max/min annuali.
- Carriere pluriennali solo con approvazioni presenti in `config/player-identities.json`; niente inferenza per nome o Gazzetta.
- L'ultimo FCM di ogni sito stabilisce il cutoff, i JS sono partizionati e non eccedono 1.500.000 byte **reali** per file.
- Le competizioni sono filtrate dalla pagina consumatrice; Java esporta tutte le competizioni presenti, GUI non aggiunge selettori di competizioni.
- Quattro skin: Mauzstrom, Fantablue2, Maelstrom, Neutral.

### Modifiche software (rispettano la baseline Git)

- `src/main/java/.../app/topflop/TopFlopIntegratedV83.java` — nuovo exporter Java nativo, read-only, basato su topflop canonico JDBC.
- `TopFlopViewsPublication.java` — integrazione unica in `prepare()` e `attachScoped()`.
- `RecordsNextPipeline.java` — asset JS nel normale staging + pubblicazione congiunta JS/pagine/CSS con backup e rollback.
- `gui/RecordsNext2Dashboard.java` — etichetta esplicita, pulsante unico invariato.
- `assets/js/fcmRecordsNextTopFlopRankingEngine_v83.js` — semantica zeri: TF20 gol/rigori/assist/totale visibili insieme e nessun primo classificato con 0.
- `assets/js/fcmRecordsNextEventRanking_v83.js`, `fcmRecordsNextFunzioni_topflop_v83.js`, `fcmRecordsNextCalciatori_v83.js` — classifica eventi, separazione ricerca, profili.
- `assets/RecordsNext/top_flop.html`, `calciatori.html`, `top_flop_v83.css` — pagine native; gli asset condivisi v79 sono riusati, non ricalcolati in JavaScript.
- `tools/Verifica-RN4-Integrazione-v83.py` — controllo RAW FCM vs JS nativo, riprende oracoli FCA v81 senza rifare audit.
- `src/test/...` e `tools/Genera-Bibbia-RecordsNext-v83.py` — regressioni e Bibbia rigenerabile.

## Limiti della verifica

Il pacchetto non include il `recordsnext.db` reale e non puo eseguire qui un test end-to-end sui 21 archivi. Sono stati eseguiti **javac** sui sorgenti principali e test sintetici Java/Node. I report RAW FCM e browser reale restano **da acquisire** sul PC.
L'audit v81 ha gia provato 205.031 voti FCA, 240.096 COUNTED (v78), 16.264 righe giocatore/stagione, Simeone 11 annate e TF20 Carnesecchi 1 assist / 0 gol.
Le famiglie classici, serie, riserve d'ufficio, modificatori, soglie/fortuna e Culometro **non sono ancora certificate da oracoli RAW indipendenti** in questo pacchetto. Le relative implementazioni esistenti non sono state alterate arbitrariamente; la parita resta un **gate bloccante per proclamare release finale**.
Due file esterni RecordsNext `persjs/fcmAlmanaccoDati.js` e `persjs/fcmTuttiGiocatoriDati.js` superavano 1.500.000 byte nell'audit v81; non attribuirli al publisher senza prova di proprieta.
558 eventi FCA senza voto valido richiedono esame per tipo di record; non vanno cancellati ne interpretati come zero.

## Sequenza di accettazione

1. Preflight stato Git, SHA originali v81 e backup. NON applicare se file sorgenti divergono dallo snapshot senza controllo.
2. Installare la singola integrazione con `Installa-RN4-Integrazione-v83.ps1 -Mode Install` in `D:\DEV_APPS\downloads`.
3. Lanciare `mvn test`, verifica Java e Node e genera/verifica/pubblica da GUI nella sandbox XAMPP, senza toccare produzione.
4. Eseguire verifica read-only con oracoli v81 e database reale. Rapporti e ZIP `RN4_COLLAUDO_RISULTATI_v83.zip` direttamente in `D:\DEV_APPS\downloads`.
5. Collaudare TF20, Simeone, Cristante, Klose, 4 skin, filtri, scorecard, cutoff precedenti, 15 indicatori e dimensioni JS.
6. Soltanto con gate RAW completi e senza regressioni, commit sul branch autorizzato e aggiornamento changelog/diario/Bibbia. Il commit non viene simulato nel pacchetto.

**Stato documento:** implementazione candidata e test locali; verifica e consolidamento Windows/Git ancora aperti.

## VINCOLI DA RISPETTARE

- Prodotto RecordsNext by mauz79; JS sono output principale; GUI **un unico** flusso Genera/Verifica/Pubblica. Le scelte di competizione sono lato HTML.
- `top_flop.html` = solo classifiche TF01–TF20, una ricerca di filtro; `calciatori.html` = ricerca storica globale e schede. Entrambe stesse fonti con shard e cutoff sito. Classifiche integrali, ordinamenti, Top 1/10/20/50/Tutti.
- Scheda contesto stagione × playerKey × fantasquadra, 15 indicatori: FCM TOT medio, VOTO medio, gol, assist, gol rigore, rigori sbagliati, ammonizioni, espulsioni, autogol, gol subiti, di cui rigore, rigori parati, **bonus punti**, **malus punti**, saldo `SUM(MODIF)`; dettaglio per competizione, metadati e badge saldo annuo max/min. Non confondere punti con numero eventi.
- Coefficienti sempre validi: gol +3, assist +1, rigore parato +3, ammonizione −0.5, espulsione −1, autogol −2, gol subito −1. Su rigore segnato +2 o +3, sbagliato −2 o −3 secondo stagione/regolamento. Split bonus/malus **solo univoco e riconciliato al MODIF**; altrimenti null/—, saldo osservato comunque presente.
- FCA giorno reale deduplicato per atleta e giornata; FCM solo prestazioni COUNTED, anche su più competizioni. Gol su rigore e gol subito su rigore sono sottoinsiemi, non eventi aggiuntivi. Non inventare rosa posseduta alla data per panchine/tribune. Zero ≠ null.
- 4 skin: Mauzstrom, Fantablue2, Maelstrom, Neutral. JS singolo max **1.500.000 byte reali**, meglio 1 MB, con shard. No `source=chatgpt` o `utm_source=chatgpt` negli URL.
- I siti storici rispettano il cutoff dell'ultimo FCM effettivo di ciascun sito, non necessariamente quello attuale 2026/27.

package it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.topflop;

import it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.config.MiniJson;
import it.alterlega.recordsnext.app.topflop.TopFlopFacts.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Integrated site-scoped Top&Flop/Calciatori exporter.
 * All source data are read from the existing JDBC canonical archive. No Python runtime,
 * no SQLite writes, no identity inference, no standalone exporter or publish shortcut.
 * Profile scoring is reconciled against the ORIGINAL FCM scorecard MODIF on every
 * actually counted position. Unknown split is null, not zero.
 */
public final class TopFlopIntegratedV83 {
    private TopFlopIntegratedV83() {}
    public static final long LIMIT = 1_500_000L;
    private static final long TARGET = 850_000L;
    private static final String MF_FULL = "fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopFull_v83.js";
    private static final String MF_FMT = "fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopFcaFmt_v83.js";
    private static final String MF_PROFILE = "fcmRecordsNext_ProfileManifest_v83.js";
    private static final List<String> EVENTS = List.of("GOLFATTI1","ASSIST","GOLFATTISURIGORE1","RIGSBA",
        "AMM","ESP","AUTOGOL1","GOLSUBITI","GOLSUBITISURIGORE","RIGPAR");
    private static final BigDecimal TOL = new BigDecimal("0.011");
    private static final BigDecimal ZERO = BigDecimal.ZERO;

    private static String js(Object value) { return TopFlopCompactStageJsExporter.Json.write(value); }
    private static Map<String,Object> obj(Object... entries) {
        Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(int i=0;i<entries.length;i+=2)out.put((String)entries[i],entries[i+1]);
        return out;
    }
    private static String sha(byte[] b) throws IOException {
        try {
            StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder();
            for(byte v:MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(b))s.append(String.format("%02x",v&255));
            return s.toString();
        }catch(Exception e){throw new IOException(e);}
    }
    private static void write(Path out,String file,String content) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes=content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if(bytes.length==0||bytes.length>LIMIT)throw new IOException("JS supera il limite: "+file+" "+bytes.length);
        Files.write(out.resolve(file),bytes,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
    }
    private static List<Map<String,Object>> shards(Path out,String season,List<?> rows,String kind) throws IOException {
        String filePrefix="fcmRecordsNext_"+(kind.equals("Points")?"ProfilePoints":"PlayerIndex")+"_v83_"+season+"_";
        String variable=kind.equals("Points")?"RecordsNextV79Points":"RecordsNextV79Index";
        String head="window."+variable+"=window."+variable+"||{};\nwindow."+variable+"[\""+season+"\"]="+
            "window."+variable+"[\""+season+"\"]||"+
            (kind.equals("Points")?"{\"schemaVersion\":\"4.0-scorecard-points-v83\",\"stagione\":\""+season+"\",\"righe\":[]}":"[]")+";\n";
        String target="window."+variable+"[\""+season+"\"]"+(kind.equals("Points")?".righe":"");
        List<Map<String,Object>> meta=new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> batch=new ArrayList<>();long length=0;int part=1;
        for(Object row:rows){String value=js(row);long n=value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length;
            if(n+head.length()+100>LIMIT)throw new IOException("Riga troppo grande per shard "+kind);
            if(!batch.isEmpty() && length+n>TARGET){meta.add(flush(out,season,kind,filePrefix,head,target,part++,batch));batch.clear();length=0;}
            batch.add(value);length+=n+1;
        }
        if(!batch.isEmpty()||meta.isEmpty())meta.add(flush(out,season,kind,filePrefix,head,target,part,batch));
        int count=meta.stream().mapToInt(x->((Number)x.get("righe")).intValue()).sum();
        if(count!=rows.size())throw new IOException("Copertura shard errata: "+kind+" "+season);
        return meta;
    }
    private static Map<String,Object> flush(Path out,String season,String kind,String pre,String head,
                                           String target,int part,List<String> batch) throws IOException {
        String name=pre+String.format("%03d",part)+".js";
        String s=head+target+".push(...["+String.join(",",batch)+"]);\n";
        write(out,name,s);byte[] bytes=s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return obj("stagione",season,"part",part,"righe",batch.size(),"nome",name,"byte",bytes.length,"sha256",sha(bytes));
    }
    private static BigDecimal number(String value){
        if(value==null || !value.trim().matches("[+-]?[0-9]+(?:[,.][0-9]+)?"))return null;
        return new BigDecimal(value.trim().replace(',','.'));
    }
    private static BigDecimal ev(Map<String,BigDecimal> data,String field){return data.getOrDefault(field,ZERO);}
    private record Split(BigDecimal bonus,BigDecimal malus,String status){}
    private static Split split(Map<String,BigDecimal> e,BigDecimal observed,Set<String> absent){
        if(!absent.isEmpty())return new Split(null,null,"MISSING_FIELDS");
        if(ev(e,"GOLFATTISURIGORE1").compareTo(ev(e,"GOLFATTI1"))>0)return new Split(null,null,"INVALID_PENALTY_SUBSET");
        if(ev(e,"GOLSUBITISURIGORE").compareTo(ev(e,"GOLSUBITI"))>0)return new Split(null,null,"INVALID_CONCEDED_SUBSET");
        BigDecimal baseBonus=ev(e,"GOLFATTI1").subtract(ev(e,"GOLFATTISURIGORE1")).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(3))
            .add(ev(e,"ASSIST")).add(ev(e,"RIGPAR").multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(3)));
        BigDecimal baseMalus=ev(e,"AMM").multiply(new BigDecimal("0.5")).add(ev(e,"ESP"))
            .add(ev(e,"AUTOGOL1").multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(2))).add(ev(e,"GOLSUBITI"));
        Map<String,Split> candidates=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(int goal:(ev(e,"GOLFATTISURIGORE1").signum()==0?new int[]{3}:new int[]{2,3}))
            for(int missed:(ev(e,"RIGSBA").signum()==0?new int[]{3}:new int[]{2,3})){
                BigDecimal bonus=baseBonus.add(ev(e,"GOLFATTISURIGORE1").multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(goal)));
                BigDecimal malus=baseMalus.add(ev(e,"RIGSBA").multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(missed)));
                if(bonus.subtract(malus).subtract(observed).abs().compareTo(TOL)<=0)
                    candidates.put(bonus.stripTrailingZeros()+"/"+malus.stripTrailingZeros(),new Split(bonus,malus,"RECONCILED"));
            }
        if(candidates.size()==1)return candidates.values().iterator().next();
        return new Split(null,null,candidates.isEmpty()?"UNEXPLAINED_MODIF":"AMBIGUOUS_SPLIT");
    }
    private static final class Points {
        final String playerKey,competition;final int team,competitionId;
        int games,pairs,modifValid,verified,errors,nonzero;
        BigDecimal total=ZERO,votes=ZERO,delta=ZERO,bonus=ZERO,malus=ZERO;
        final Map<String,Long> events=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        final Map<String,Integer> unresolved=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        final Set<String> missing=new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Points(String p,int t,int c,String name,Set<String> absent){playerKey=p;team=t;competitionId=c;competition=name;missing.addAll(absent);}
        void add(FantasyFact fact,Set<String> absent) throws IOException {
            games++;total=total.add(fact.fantasyVote());
            Map<String,BigDecimal> e=fact.fantasyEvents();
            for(String name:EVENTS){BigDecimal v=ev(e,name);
                if(v.signum()<0 || v.stripTrailingZeros().scale()>0)throw new IOException("Evento FCA non intero "+playerKey+"/"+name);
                events.merge(name,v.longValueExact(),Long::sum);
            }
            var raw=fact.sourceFields();
            BigDecimal vote=number(raw.get("FCM.Tabellino.Voto"));
            BigDecimal modifier=number(raw.get("FCM.Tabellino.Modif"));
            if(vote==null){reason("VOTO_NON_NUMERICO");return;}
            pairs++;votes=votes.add(vote);
            BigDecimal difference=fact.fantasyVote().subtract(vote);delta=delta.add(difference);
            if(modifier==null || modifier.subtract(difference).abs().compareTo(TOL)>0){reason("MODIF_INCONSISTENT");return;}
            modifValid++;if(modifier.signum()!=0)nonzero++;
            Split r=split(e,modifier,absent);
            if(r.status.equals("RECONCILED")){verified++;bonus=bonus.add(r.bonus);malus=malus.add(r.malus);}
            else reason(r.status);
        }
        void reason(String s){errors++;unresolved.merge(s,1,Integer::sum);}
        Map<String,Object> asRow(){
            boolean complete=games>0&&games==pairs&&games==verified;
            Map<String,Object> mappedEvents=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for(String name:EVENTS)mappedEvents.put(name,missing.contains(name)?null:events.getOrDefault(name,0L));
            return obj("playerKey",playerKey,"idSquadraInterno",team,"idCompetizioneInterno",competitionId,
              "competizione",competition,"gare",games,"totSum",total,
              "votoFcmSum",pairs==games?votes:null,"pairs",pairs,
              "deltaNetTabellino",pairs==games?delta:null,"bonusPunti",complete?bonus:null,
              "malusPunti",complete?malus:null,"saldoPunti",modifValid==games?delta:null,
              "certified",complete,"ruleSource",complete?List.of("FCM MODIF; coefficienti confermati e varianti rigore ricostruite"):List.of(),
              "ruleMismatches",errors,"modifNonzero",nonzero,"unresolvedReasons",unresolved,
              "pointsMethod","FCM_MODIF_NATIVE_JAVA_v83","events",mappedEvents,
              "missingSourceFields",new ArrayList<>(missing));
        }
    }
    private static Set<String> missingFcaFields(Connection c,String season) throws SQLException {
        String table="raw_"+season+"_fca_punteggio";
        Set<String> found=new HashSet<>();
        try(var s=c.createStatement();var r=s.executeQuery("PRAGMA table_info(\""+table+"\")")){
            while(r.next())found.add(r.getString("name").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        }
        if(found.isEmpty())throw new SQLException("Tabella FCA assente: "+table);
        Set<String> absent=new LinkedHashSet<>(EVENTS);absent.removeAll(found);return absent;
    }
    private static List<Map<String,Object>> points(String season,TopFlopArchive archive,Set<String> absent) throws IOException {
        Map<String,Points> grouped=new TreeMap<>();Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();
        for(FantasyFact f:archive.allFantasyFacts()){
            if(f.usage()!=Usage.COUNTED)continue;
            if(f.fantasyVote()==null)throw new IOException("COUNTED senza TOT "+f.key());
            String unique=f.key().player().fcaPlayerId()+":"+f.key().fantasyTeamId()+":"
                +f.key().sourceCompetitionId()+":"+f.key().matchId();
            if(!seen.add(unique))throw new IOException("FCM COUNTED duplicato "+season+" "+unique);
            String player=season+":"+f.key().player().fcaPlayerId();
            int team=f.key().fantasyTeamId(),competition=f.key().sourceCompetitionId();
            String key=player+"/"+team+"/"+competition;
            Points p=grouped.computeIfAbsent(key,k->new Points(player,team,competition,f.competitionName(),absent));
            if(!p.competition.equals(f.competitionName()))throw new IOException("Competizione FCM incoerente: "+key);
            p.add(f,absent);
        }
        return grouped.values().stream().map(Points::asRow).toList();
    }
    private static Map<String,Object> fmtSeason(Connection c,String season,
            TopFlopJdbcArchiveAssembler.LoadedSeason loaded,TopFlopRealFantasyRules rules) throws SQLException {
        var result=TopFlopFcaOfficialFantasy.extract(c,season,loaded,rules.forSeason(season));
        Map<String,Object> players=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(Map<String,Object> r:result.rows()){
            String key=(String)r.get("playerKey"),id=key.substring(key.indexOf(':')+1);
            players.put(id,Arrays.asList(r.get("votiRealiValidi"),r.get("fantamediaReale"),r.get("stato")));
        }
        return players;
    }
    private static List<Object> index(String season,TopFlopJdbcArchiveAssembler.LoadedSeason loaded,
                                      Map<String,String> approved){
        List<Object> rows=new ArrayList<>();
        loaded.profiles().values().stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(x->x.player().fcaPlayerId())).forEach(p->{
            String key=season+":"+p.player().fcaPlayerId();var fields=p.originalFields();
            String canon=approved.getOrDefault(key,key);
            rows.add(List.of(key,canon,p.name(),
                clean(fields.get("GiocatoreA.DATADINASCITA")),
                p.player().gazzaCode()==null?"":p.player().gazzaCode().toString(),
                clean(fields.get("GiocatoreA.RUOLO"))));
        });
        return rows;
    }
    private static String clean(String v){return v==null||v.equals("__SQL_NULL__")?"":v;}
    public static void stage(Connection c,Path reports,List<String> seasons,Path output,
                             Map<String,String> approved,TopFlopRealFantasyRules rules) throws Exception {
        if(seasons.isEmpty()||seasons.stream().distinct().count()!=seasons.size())throw new IOException("Stagioni invalide");
        List<Object> full=new ArrayList<>(),fmt=new ArrayList<>();
        List<Map<String,Object>> allPoints=new ArrayList<>(),allIndex=new ArrayList<>();
        for(String season:seasons){
            if(!season.matches("[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{4}"))throw new IOException("Stagione non valida "+season);
            var loaded=TopFlopJdbcArchiveAssembler.loadSeason(c,season);
            var links=reports==null?Map.<TopFlopCanonicalScorecards.MatchTeam,String>of():
                TopFlopCanonicalScorecards.load(reports,season);
            Map<Integer,Integer> roles=new LinkedHashMap<>();
            loaded.profiles().forEach((id,p)->{int role=-1;
                try{role=Integer.parseInt(p.originalFields().get("GiocatoreA.RUOLO"));}catch(RuntimeException ignored){}
                roles.put(id,role);
            });
            var real=TopFlopFullPerformancesV69.real(loaded.archive(),roles);
            var counted=TopFlopFullPerformancesV69.counted(loaded.archive(),links);
            var fileInfos=new ArrayList<TopFlopPublicViewsStageExporter.FileInfo>();
            fileInfos.addAll(TopFlopPublicViewsStageExporter.shard(output,season,"RealPerformances",real));
            fileInfos.addAll(TopFlopPublicViewsStageExporter.shard(output,season,"CountedPerformances",counted));
            full.add(obj("stagione",season,"reali",real.size(),"conteggiati",counted.size(),"files",
                fileInfos.stream().map(f->obj("nome",f.name(),"tipo",f.kind(),"righe",f.rows(),"byte",f.bytes(),"sha256",f.sha256())).toList()));
            Map<String,Object> official=fmtSeason(c,season,loaded,rules);
            String fmtFile="fcmRecordsNext_TopFlopFcaFmt_v83_"+season+".js";
            write(output,fmtFile,"window.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70=window.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70||{};\n"+
                "window.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtV70[\""+season+"\"]="+js(official)+";\n");
            fmt.add(obj("stagione",season,"nome",fmtFile,"righe",official.size()));
            allPoints.addAll(shards(output,season,points(season,loaded.archive(),missingFcaFields(c,season)),"Points"));
            allIndex.addAll(shards(output,season,index(season,loaded,approved),"Index"));
        }
        write(output,MF_FULL,"window.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopFullV69 = "+js(obj(
            "schemaVersion","4.0-full-performances-v69","eventi",TopFlopFullPerformancesV69.EVENTS,
            "stagioni",full,"limiteByteJs",LIMIT))+";\n");
        write(output,MF_FMT,"window.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtManifestV70 = "+js(obj(
            "schemaVersion","4.0-real-fmt-v70","stagioni",fmt))+";\n");
        write(output,MF_PROFILE,"window.RecordsNextV79Manifest = "+js(obj(
            "schemaVersion","4.0-profile-v79","seasons",seasons,"points",allPoints,"index",allIndex,
            "rulesStatus","FCM MODIF checked; bonus/malus only for unique reconstruction"))+";\n");
    }
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<String,Object> readManifest(Path source,String prefix) throws IOException {
        String s=Files.readString(source,StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
        if(!s.startsWith(prefix)||!s.endsWith(";"))throw new IOException("Manifest JS invalido "+source);
        return (Map<String,Object>)MiniJson.parse(s.substring(prefix.length(),s.length()-1));
    }
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static int attach(Path prepared,List<String> scope,Path output) throws IOException {
        Map<String,Object> full=readManifest(prepared.resolve(MF_FULL),"window.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopFullV69 = ");
        Map<String,Object> fmt=readManifest(prepared.resolve(MF_FMT),"window.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtManifestV70 = ");
        Map<String,Object> profile=readManifest(prepared.resolve(MF_PROFILE),"window.RecordsNextV79Manifest = ");
        Set<String> allowed=new HashSet<>((List<String>)profile.get("seasons"));
        if(!allowed.containsAll(scope)||scope.size()!=new HashSet<>(scope).size())throw new IOException("Cutoff profile non valido");
        List<Object> fullScoped=new ArrayList<>(),fmtScoped=new ArrayList<>();
        List<Map<String,Object>> points=new ArrayList<>(),index=new ArrayList<>();Set<String> names=new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for(Object o:(List<?>)full.get("stagioni")){
            Map<String,Object> row=(Map<String,Object>)o;
            if(!scope.contains(row.get("stagione")))continue;
            fullScoped.add(row);
            for(Object f:(List<?>)row.get("files"))names.add((String)((Map<?,?>)f).get("nome"));
        }
        for(Object o:(List<?>)fmt.get("stagioni")){
            Map<String,Object> row=(Map<String,Object>)o;
            if(scope.contains(row.get("stagione"))){fmtScoped.add(row);names.add((String)row.get("nome"));}
        }
        for(Object o:(List<?>)profile.get("points")){
            Map<String,Object> row=(Map<String,Object>)o;
            if(scope.contains(row.get("stagione"))){points.add(row);names.add((String)row.get("nome"));}
        }
        for(Object o:(List<?>)profile.get("index")){
            Map<String,Object> row=(Map<String,Object>)o;
            if(scope.contains(row.get("stagione"))){index.add(row);names.add((String)row.get("nome"));}
        }
        if(fullScoped.size()!=scope.size()||fmtScoped.size()!=scope.size())throw new IOException("Dati fonte incompleti nel cutoff");
        for(String n:names){
            if(n.contains("/")||n.contains("\\")||!n.endsWith(".js"))throw new IOException("Nome shard non valido: "+n);
            Path src=prepared.resolve(n),dest=output.resolve(n);
            if(!Files.isRegularFile(src)||Files.size(src)>LIMIT||Files.exists(dest))throw new IOException("Shard duplicato/assente/sovradimensionato "+src);
            Files.copy(src,dest);
        }
        full.put("stagioni",fullScoped);fmt.put("stagioni",fmtScoped);
        profile.put("seasons",scope);profile.put("points",points);profile.put("index",index);
        write(output,MF_FULL,"window.fcmRecordsNextTopFlopFullV69 = "+js(full)+";\n");
        write(output,MF_FMT,"window.fcmRecordsNextFcaFmtManifestV70 = "+js(fmt)+";\n");
        write(output,MF_PROFILE,"window.RecordsNextV79Manifest = "+js(profile)+";\n");
        return names.size()+3;
    }
}
